name: Gameboy Enhanced Firmware
description:
Cardputer & Adv; New faster cpu emulation core('fastest' mode in cpu settings, the default unless I get incompatibilty reports). Cycle available scales using the \ button. Change vertical scale & alignment using Fn+\ Check back often for latest updates.

Gameboy Emulator; complete with configurable controls, audio, display and performance options, savegames, save states, filesystem navigation and no .gb rom file size limits imposed by memory. Various other enhancements. Accurate palettes. Partial Super Gameboy Enhancement support, including borders. Extended 12 colour mode, along with all official/original GBC palettes. 44 Analogue Pocket 12 colour community palettes included with automatic mapping of titles to AP palettes partially implemented. Pokemon Silver/Gold,  Dragon Warrior I&II and Azure dreams are the only confirmed fully supported .gbc titles, backwards compatible with the original gameboy and run in that mode. Emulator will behave as if you placed a gameboy colour cartridge into an original gameboy in most instances. Feel free to try other backwards compatible gbc games, but no garuntees on compatiblity. All *.gb and *.gbc files are listed by the file explorer in the current directory.

Read the instructions at the bottom for controls. Forked from original gb_cardputer implementation. As of version 0.75 a launcher is no longer required, versions prior to that have no bootloader merged so if you are having issues try using m5launcher to install.

Save states can be used by pressing the minus/underscore key to load,  and backspace/del to save.

Hold Fn and press the left arrow to mute audio
Hold Fn and press the right arrow to jump to 50/100% volume
Hold Fn and press the up/down arrows to change volume in smaller adjustments.

29.05.2024:v0.61
* Memory solution devised was based on two ideas: Assume stastically random access patterns, and place no limits on addressable space.
The reality is that the gameboy games never exceed 8megabits (1megabyte); Taking advantage of the limitations of the gameboy, I have removed the generalized nature of the	previous solution in favor of one that provides a deterministic approach to page seeking, with the tradeoff that no games larger than a real game boy game can be loaded any longer. This should not pose an issue for any (valid) title. This has increased frame rates slightly all around and made them much steadier; page location has no bearing on access times. Page seek times are fixed, and a minor amount of page maintenance is done at these intervals, distributed across successive calls still. This would be deterministic page seeking mixed with the previous progressive pruning.
* Added Error messages with regards to writing save game files, attempts to do so when there is no cart ram
* Added Error messages specific to the case of being unable to open a file vs. file size 0 (was ambiguous before)
* Removed pause associated with automatic savegames; bars operate on a timer now and will disappear 1second after pending write is completed

19.05.2024:v0.492
* Reimplemented memory subsystem to use progressive partial page seeking/pruning; the original memory management code was the first I had typed in 14 years; after some thought I devised something much more suitable for a real time environment. This resulted in the average page seek time being much lower, and distributes maintenance of the paging system across successive calls. The results are the largest improvement to speed to date. Over double the frame rates from before; less stutter, smoother page transitions in memory. Donkey Kong Land averages around 45fps now; Super Mario land 2 gets an average 53fps on the overworld.

18.05.2024:v0.491
* Reduced rendering workload 6.25% by modifying peanut_gb to inherently skip lines that aren't visible due to scaling.
This prevents the engine from having to process the layer and sprite data for these lines all together. Why 6.25%? because 9 lines are skipped which is 6.25% of the lines that were rendered previously.

name: Groqputer UNIFIED- CUSTOM! Personality Chatbot - Whisplay Groq Companion
description:
Groqputer is a standalone M5Cardputer OR M5CardputerADV  Groq chatbot firmware built inside the WhisplayGroqHat repo.
You can do some pretty strange stuff with this. Now a unified project. 
It is designed to be 100% free to start with Groq's very generous request limits, which makes it a good fit for an always-available pocket chatbot build.

It is meant to be a small, useful Cardputer chat build first:
I will be updating this project. 
I was going to add an MP3 player and streaming radio path. But that did not happen today. Maybe next month.

Now with some of my favorite screensavers. 
PLUS NOW hit Fn+Spacebar for a command list. 
Navigate hitting Fn + arrow
BtnA=BtnGO press BtnGO to use MIC!

direct Groq chat
direct Groq Whisper transcription
local Wi-Fi setup AP
editable personality prompt
on-device model/personality switching
saved custom personalities from the AP or Cardputer
optional 16x2 I2C LCD companion display
NOTE: THE OPTIONAL lCD ONLY WORKS WHEN PLUGGED IN. 
I don't know why, it works fine on the CORE2. I have given up trying to figure out the issue and have chalked it off as hardware limit for now. 
early same-LAN Whisplay relay testing
Why it exists
Groqputer started as a pivot from the larger Whisplay project so the Cardputer could become its own simple Groq bot instead of depending on a Raspberry Pi host.

The long-term hope is still to let Groqputer connect back into the Whisplay ecosystem more cleanly, but the first goal is a dependable standalone Cardputer chatbot.

Demo


Current status
Working now:

standalone keyboard chat
hold-to-record voice input
direct Groq Whisper transcription
direct Groq replies
saved local chat history
full-screen incoming/outgoing reader
toggleable vertical or horizontal bot reply reader
saved chat font color and background theme presets
reduced Cardputer redraw flicker
battery level in the top header
on-device bot settings
AP save/delete for custom personalities
on-device Fn+V custom personality flow with save / test / cancel
hotkey help screen
setup AP with saved Wi-Fi and Groq settings
optional 16x2 I2C LCD output
NWS weather routed through the active persona
ESP32-CAM capture with on-device photo browser
wireless companion-display API for external viewers
boot-to-Matrix screensaver
idle screensaver system with saved mode + timeout
merged M5Burner-ready firmware image
Current experimental feature:

Connected Device / LAN mode can send prompts to a Whisplay node over the local network and read back the displayed reply
Included firmware image
This folder includes a merged firmware image for easier flashing:

Groqputer_M5Cardputer-MERGED.bin
This image includes the bootloader, partitions, boot app, and main firmware in one file.

After flashing the merged image, the Cardputer may show a blank screen for a short while during boot. Give it roughly up to a minute before assuming the flash failed.

Setup
Flash the firmware.
Boot the Cardputer.
On a fresh flash, the Cardputer now shows a setup instruction screen instead of sitting blank.
Join the setup AP shown on-screen:
Groqputer-Setup
Open:
http://192.168.4.1
Open the setup AP later with Fn+A if needed.
Save:
Wi-Fi SSID/password
Groq API key
chat model
personality prompt
optional ESP32-CAM URL for remote photo capture
optional weather latitude / longitude for NWS forecast + alerts
screensaver mode for idle use
idle screensaver delay in seconds
preferred reader mode
chat font color preset
background theme preset
optional custom bot saves from that current prompt
max record seconds
optional This Device URL
optional Connected Device URL
Save and let the Cardputer reboot.
Groq API key setup
Create or sign in to your Groq account.
Open the Groq API keys page.
Create a new key.
Paste that key into the Groq API Key field in the setup AP.
After that, Groqputer can use direct Groq chat and direct Groq Whisper transcription.

Important first-boot note
If Groqputer is not configured yet, it does not mean the firmware is broken.

On first boot it should now show setup instructions on the Cardputer screen and wait in the AP setup flow until Wi-Fi and the Groq key are saved.

If the screen stays blank immediately after flashing, wait a bit before retrying. The merged image can take a little time to come up on the first boot.

For Whisplay relay testing, the connected device URL should be the Whisplay browser base URL, for example:

http://10.160.0.136:17880
For wireless companion displays such as the Core1 viewer firmware, point them at the Groqputer base URL and poll:

http://<groqputer-ip>/api/companion/chat
Hotkeys
Enter = send typed message
Hold BtnA = record voice message
Fn+A = open setup AP
Fn+Space = open command browser
Fn+H = alternate command browser shortcut
Fn+M = incoming view
Fn+O = outgoing view
Fn+S = settings screen
Fn+B = bot settings
Fn+V = custom personality flow
Fn+P = ask for the weather
Fn+W = toggle vertical or horizontal reply reader
Fn+X = start screensaver preview
Fn+G = capture photo from ESP32-CAM to SD
Fn+I = open saved photo browser
Fn+T = rotate current photo in the browser
Fn+C = connected-device / LAN mode on or off
Fn+N = new chat
Fn+; / Fn+. = read pages or seek the marquee
Fn+, / Fn+/ = previous / next turn
Fn+[ / Fn+] = slower / faster shared scroll speed
Fn+1 / Fn+2 = LCD backlight off / on
Fn++ / Fn+- = Cardputer text size up / down
Any key / BtnA tap while screensaver is active = wake back to chat
Command browser
Groqputer now includes a compact on-device command browser for the tiny screen:

Fn+Space opens or closes it
Fn+H still opens the same browser
Fn+; / Fn+. moves between items
Fn+, / Fn+/ switches between Hotkeys and Voice sections
The browser currently covers the main hotkeys plus supported weather/camera voice triggers, so you do not have to keep checking the README while using the device.

Theme presets
Groqputer now lets you tune the display without editing code:

Chat Font Color changes the reader text color
Background Theme recolors the full screen + panel backgrounds
includes a Multicolor chat-font option
You can change both from:

the Fn+S settings screen
the setup AP at 192.168.4.1
Reader modes
Groqputer now supports two reader styles:

Vertical = wrapped reply pages
Horizontal = a marquee reply with your last prompt scrolling in a strip above it
Switch it with:

Fn+W
the Reader row inside Fn+S settings
the Reader Mode field in the setup AP
Screensavers
Groqputer now boots into a Matrix saver by default after setup is complete. After that, idle behavior can be controlled from the setup AP or the on-device Settings screen.

Current saver set:

Matrix
Random Shuffle
Bouncing Balls
Kaleidoscope
Tetris Rain
Starfield
Critical
Plasma
On-device controls:

open Settings with Fn+S
use Fn+; / Fn+. to move between Saver and Idle saver
use Fn+, / Fn+/ to change the selected value
use Fn+X to preview the currently selected saver immediately
Set Idle Screensaver Delay to:

0 to disable idle screensaver activation
any positive value to return to the selected saver after inactivity
Weather
Set Weather Latitude and Weather Longitude in the setup AP, then ask:

"What's the weather?"
"Where's the weather?"
"weather forecast"
"weather alerts"
Groqputer fetches NOAA/NWS forecast + alerts for the saved coordinates, then replies in the style of the currently active persona instead of dumping raw utility text.

ESP32-CAM capture
Set ESP32-CAM URL in the setup AP, for example:

http://10.160.0.178
Then either:

press Fn+G
or type "take photo" / "capture image"
Groqputer polls the remote camera, downloads the latest JPEG, saves it to the SD card under /camera/, and opens the newest photo inside the Cardputer content window.

Use Fn+I to reopen the photo browser later, Fn+, and Fn+/ to move backward and forward through saved captures, and Fn+T to rotate the current image in 90-degree steps.

Optional 16x2 LCD companion
If the external I2C LCD is connected, Groqputer uses it like this:

Top row: active model tag plus the last submitted prompt scrolling across the remaining space
Bottom row: current incoming bot reply, scrolling when needed
Model tags are compact 3-character labels such as:

L31 = llama-3.1 family
L33 = llama-3.3 family
QWN = qwen family
CMP = groq compound family
GPT = openai family
BOT = fallback for anything else
Special states still override the top row when needed, such as recording and no-WiFi/setup mode.

Wireless companion endpoint
Groqputer now exposes a lightweight JSON endpoint for external viewers on the same LAN:

/api/companion/chat
The response includes the current model tag, persona label, latest submitted user prompt, latest bot reply, and a compact status field such as thinking, reply_ready, or error.

Bot settings controls
When Bot Settings is open:

Fn+; / Fn+. = move between Model and Personality
Fn+, / Fn+/ = cycle selected value and save immediately
Custom personality flow
Press Fn+V to open the staged custom-bot flow:

Type what the bot should be and press Enter.
Type the bot name and press Enter.
Choose:
Y = save the bot and make it active
T = test it right now without saving
N = cancel
Custom bots can be saved from the Cardputer or the AP, but they can only be deleted from the AP.

Personality presets
Groqputer currently includes these built-in presets:

Neutral
Friendly
Cranky
Roast Puter
Sleepy Puter
Affirmation
Philosopher
Mythic Oracle
Joke Bot
Tutor
Detective
Zen
Saved custom bots are merged into the same personality selector in Bot Settings, so you can cycle through built-ins and your saved custom bots from the Cardputer itself.

Creating a good custom personality
The best custom personalities are usually clear, narrow, and behavior-focused instead of trying to describe a whole novel character in one block.

A good prompt usually includes
Role - who the bot is
Tone - how it should sound
Behavior limits - what it should avoid
Answer style - short, detailed, step-by-step, playful, etc.
Special handling - how it should treat photos, troubleshooting, jokes, or encouragement
Good pattern
You are a calm handheld workshop assistant for a pocket Groqputer.
Keep replies practical, direct, and short unless the user asks for more detail.
When troubleshooting, list the most likely cause first.
Be friendly, but do not sound fake or overly excited.
If a photo is provided, describe what you see first, then suggest the next useful action.
Tips that usually help
Give the bot a job, not just a mood
Ask for a reply style like concise, step-by-step, or playful-but-useful
Add one or two hard boundaries, such as:
do not ramble
do not be mean
do not answer in character so hard that the advice becomes unclear
If you want humor, ask for light humor that still answers clearly
If you want a themed bot, still tell it to stay useful first
What to avoid
too many conflicting traits in one prompt
very long backstories that do not change how the bot answers
prompts that only say "be funny" or "be cool" without telling it how to help
prompts that ask for a tone but never define answer length or usefulness
Easy recipe
If you want a reliable custom bot, use this formula:

You are a [role].
Sound [tone].
Keep replies [length/style].
When helping, prioritize [main goal].
Do not [limit 1] or [limit 2].
If images are provided, [image behavior].
Example custom personalities
Pocket mechanic

You are a pocket mechanic assistant.
Sound practical, slightly gritty, and confident.
Keep replies short and focused on the next physical check to make.
When troubleshooting, start with the most likely failure point.
Do not ramble or turn simple advice into theory.
Encouraging builder

You are an encouraging project coach for small electronics builds.
Sound warm, grounded, and honest.
Keep replies concise, but include the next best step.
Notice what is already working before suggesting fixes.
Do not use fake hype or empty praise.
Mythic field guide

You are a mythic field guide living inside a tiny Groqputer.
Speak with a little dramatic flair, but always answer clearly.
Keep replies compact and readable on a handheld screen.
For photos, describe what is visible first, then give the practical takeaway.
Do not become cryptic enough to hide the answer.
Best workflow
Start with a short prompt.
Use Fn+V and choose T to test it without saving.
If the tone is close but not right, edit the wording to be more specific.
Save it only when it is actually behaving the way you want.
If you outgrow it later, delete it from the AP and make a cleaner version.
Optional 16x2 I2C LCD
Current target:

HD44780 16x2 LCD with I2C backpack
Current behavior:

line 1 = compact status
line 2 = scrolling incoming reply text
Current note:

backlight can be toggled from the Cardputer
true brightness control is not supported by the current LCD backpack library
battery readability on the tested 1602 display appears to be a hardware limitation, so a future 1.3 inch I2C display is a likely next direction
Connected-device / LAN mode
This mode is for early testing against another bot on the same LAN, especially Whisplay.

Current behavior:

Groqputer sends the prompt to the configured connected device
the peer device answers using its own normal chatbot/personality flow
Groqputer reads that reply back and shows it locally
This is currently a simple relay path, not the full BotNet conversation engine yet.
Do you hate the screen? and own a CORE1... And use platformio? Or want to download a .bin that you can download and flash manually on the M5Burner? Check out my repo in the Groqputer folder. Otherwise. Coming soon to the M5Burner.

Future direction
Planned or likely future work:

local daily message / reply counter
better peer / BotNet integration
improved external display support
possible 1.3 inch I2C display support for better battery behavior
tighter Whisplay-side integration after the standalone firmware is more mature

Device restarts and connects automatically.

Access endpoints like /api/sensors, /api/gyro, /api/accel, and /api/buttons to get JSON data. Ideal for IoT experiments, prototyping, or building sensor-based applications. name: HaM5-MP3Player
description:
The HaM5dsp-MP3Player ("Free Version M1.0.0") transforms the HaM5dsp device into a dedicated, premium, standalone audio player designed for high-fidelity playback of MP3 files from an SD card. This version has been decoupled from any licensing requirements and boots directly and exclusively into the music player interface.

The interface offers an extremely fluid user experience, combining hierarchical navigation (the "Cassette" system), precise touch control assisted by a native haptic engine, and an adaptive "Dual InfoZone" display. The user experience is complex and highly interactive: users are encouraged to explore the functionalities by executing short and long touches on various UI elements across the screen (for example, a long press on the battery icon reveals hidden power management details).

Furthermore, the device highlights an impressive visual VU-meter on the lateral LED strips, extended support for high-capacity memory cards (exFAT), and the ability to manipulate playback seamlessly with features like Continuous Seek or Smart Shuffle.

name: Hacker News Top Stories PLUS Live Comments
description:
HackerCore — Hacker News for M5Stack Core

Live Hacker News top stories, per-story comments, and a rolling global live comment feed on your M5Stack Core1 / Basic.

Features
📰 Top Stories feed — 15 front-page stories with points, comment count, and domain
📖 Story detail — title, author, domain, and age
💬 Per-story comments — most recent comments, scrollable with auto-advance
🔴 LIVE comment feed — rolling global newest comments across all stories
🔒 HOLD mode — lock the live feed to a single story thread (25 deep)
📷 QR code — scan to open the full HN discussion in a browser
⚙️ Captive portal setup — configure WiFi, font color, and font size on first boot
💾 Settings persist to NVS flash — survives reboots
Controls
FEED mode — story list with cursor selection
Button	Short Press	Long Press (hold ~0.6s)
A (left)	Cursor up	Enter LIVE feed
B (middle)	Open selected story	Refresh stories
C (right)	Cursor down	—
TOP mode — single story detail
Button	Short Press	Long Press
A (left)	Previous story	Back to FEED
B (middle)	Open comments	Show QR code
C (right)	Next story	—
CMTS mode — per-story comments
Button	Short Press	Long Press
A (left)	Scroll text up	Previous comment
B (middle)	Back to story (TOP)	Toggle auto-scroll
C (right)	Scroll text down	Next comment
LIVE mode — global live comment feed
Button	Short Press	Long Press
A (left)	Previous comment	Toggle HOLD / FREE
B (middle)	Back to FEED	Toggle auto-scroll
C (right)	Next comment	—
QR mode
Press any button to return to the story.

Hold BtnA during the 3-second boot window to re-enter setup and change WiFi or settings.

LIVE Feed — HOLD Mode
In LIVE mode, long-press BtnA to lock onto the story thread of the currently displayed comment. The header turns yellow and a yellow dot replaces the red live indicator. The feed loads the 25 most recent comments for that story thread. Long-press BtnA again to FREE and return to the global live feed.

Setup (First Boot)
Power on the M5Stack — it will broadcast a WiFi AP called HackerCYD_Setup
Connect your phone or PC to that network
A CAPTIVE PORTAL SHOULD OPEN IF IT DOES NOT THEN TURN OFF YOUR MOBILE DATA AND FOLLOW THE STEP FOR OPENING IN YOUR BROSWER!
Open a browser and go to 192.168.4.1
Enter your WiFi credentials and choose your preferences:
Font color theme (Orange, Green, Blue, Cyan, White, Multicolor)
Font size (Small / Medium / Large)
Tap Save & Connect — the device will connect and start loading stories

Note: photo is of MEDIUM text. 
 
Created by Coreymillia

name: Hog On Spectrum - Analyzer & Sniffer HUD
description:
Due to so many people loving this feature i decided to port it over to the StickS3.... 

A lightweight, real-time 2.4GHz Wi-Fi channel traffic and spectrum monitor designed for M5Stack devices using the M5Unified framework.

🛠️ Key Features
Real-Time Spectrum Graph: Visualizes ambient Wi-Fi activity across channels 1–13 using cascading, decaying parabolic curves with a retro vertical-scan look.

Live Target HUD: A passive ticker at the bottom displays the latest intercepted packet's signal strength (RSSI), channel, and encryption type (WPA2/OPEN).

Matrix Aesthetic: High-visibility, classic terminal-green interface optimized for 240x135 landscape displays.

Interactive Toggle: Click the main or side button to seamlessly switch between the live analyzer and the credits page.

📜 Credits & Attribution
This firmware is a customized implementation derived from the original work of 0ct0sec. All core logic, visual style, and inspiration credits belong to them.

name: Jogos do Brasil
description:
Desenvolvi um aplicativo autônomo de alto padrão para o M5Stack Cardputer focado em acompanhar a Seleção Brasileira na Copa do Mundo de 2026. A ideia foi criar um dispositivo IoT que funciona em "piloto automático", sem precisar de celular por perto.

O app consome dados da API de futebol em tempo real e possui uma interface "Dark Mode" elegante, otimizada para o display de 240x135.

✨ Principais Funcionalidades:

    ⚽ Sequestro de Tela "Matchday": Se o Brasil estiver em campo, o app detecta automaticamente e transforma a tela principal em um placar focado na Seleção, com destaque em Verde e Amarelo.

    🔊 Alerta Sonoro de Gol: O Cardputer apita quando o placar muda! (Conta com um atalho dedicado M para mutar o som rapidamente quando necessário).

    🔄 Piloto Automático: Esqueça o F5. O sistema sincroniza os dados sozinho a cada 20 segundos em segundo plano.

    📅 Agenda Integrada: Quando o Brasil não está jogando ao vivo, a aba principal exibe automaticamente o calendário offline das próximas partidas da fase de grupos.

    🌍 Radar do Mundo (Aba 2): Uma aba dedicada para navegar e acompanhar os placares de todas as outras seleções que estiverem jogando no momento.

    🛜 Wi-Fi Manager (Aba 3): Interface nativa para escanear redes e digitar a senha direto pelo teclado do Cardputer, sem precisar colocar credenciais no código.

Tudo programado em C++ usando as bibliotecas nativas do Cardputer e ArduinoJson. Preparado para o Hexa!

name: JousTris - Atari Joust Remake - Tetrimino Game *M5StickC Plus2
description:
*Requires Mini JoyC Hat*
🎮 JousTris
Classic Joust Meets Tetris on M5StickC Plus2!

Fly on S and Z tetromino pieces as birds in this arcade-style aerial combat game. Battle enemies, collect eggs before they hatch, and survive endless waves of increasing difficulty!

✨ Features
Core Gameplay
🐦 Classic Joust Physics - Gravity-based flight with flap mechanics
🎨 Tetromino Birds - S and Z pieces that flip based on direction
⚔️ Height-Based Combat - Higher position wins collisions
🥚 Egg System - Defeated enemies drop eggs that hatch if not collected
🦖 Pterodactyl Hazard - Anti-camping punishment for stalling
🔥 Lava Bottom - Deadly hazard at screen bottom
🌀 Screen Wrapping - Seamless left/right edge wrapping
Advanced Systems
🧠 Smart AI - Limited hunters (1-3) actively chase you, others wander
🏔️ Procedural Platforms - Fresh layout every wave
📈 Endless Progression - Difficulty scales infinitely
💾 Safe Respawn - Smart spawn checking with invulnerability
🎯 God Mode - Invincible testing/practice mode
🚀 Auto-Flap - Continuous flapping accessibility option
🛠️ Hardware Requirements
Required
M5StickC Plus2 
Mini JoyC Hat 

🕹️ Controls
JoyC Mini Hat
Joystick Left/Right - Fly horizontally
JoyC Button - Flap wings (tap or hold)
M5StickC Plus2 Buttons
Button A (M5) - Toggle Auto-Flap mode
Button B (Side) - Toggle God Mode
Control Modes
Normal Mode - Tap button to flap (classic arcade)
Auto-Flap Mode - Hold button for continuous flapping (4 flaps/sec)
God Mode - Invincible, instant kills from any angle
🎮 Gameplay
Objective
Survive endless waves by defeating enemy birds and collecting eggs before they hatch into stronger enemies.

Combat Rules
Higher Y position wins - Attack from above!
Same height - Bounce apart
Lower position - You lose a life
God Mode - Win from any angle
Enemies
Hunters (1-3 per wave) - Actively chase you
Wanderers - Patrol randomly across the board
Pterodactyls - Spawn if you stall, must hit head to kill
Scoring
Defeat enemy: 50 points
Collect egg: +points
Defeat pterodactyl: 100 points
Wave Progression
Wave	Enemies	Hunters	AI Speed	Egg Hatch	Pterodactyl Timer
1-2	-------------4-------1------1.0x------6 sec-----------30 sec
3-8	----5-7---------2------------------1.4-2.0x----4-3 sec---27-22 sec
9+--------8---------3------------2.2x+-------2 sec--------20-15 sec

Enemy AI States
Wander - Random horizontal movement
Chase - Pursue player horizontally, try to get above
Flee - Move away from player
Hunter Assignment
Wave 1-2: 1 hunter, rest wander
Wave 3-8: 2 hunters, rest wander
Wave 9+: 3 hunters (max), rest wander
Dead hunters are replaced automatically
Egg Mechanics
Drop when enemy defeated
Fall with gravity, land on platforms
Hatch timer: 6s (Wave 1) → 2s (Wave 10+)
Flash red in last 1.5 seconds
Hatch into stronger enemies if not collected
Pterodactyl
Spawn Trigger:
Wave takes >30s (decreases to 15s by Wave 15)
Player idle with eggs >15s (decreases to 8s)
Behavior: Homes in on player position
Speed: 3.0 → 5.0 (increases with wave)
Kill Method: Must hit tiny red head hitbox (precision)
God Mode: Instant kill from any angle
Respawn System
Death: 0.8 second delay
Spawn Check: Finds safe location away from enemies/eggs
Invulnerability: 2 seconds (flashing sprite)
Lives: Start with 3, game over at 0

👏 Credits
Game Design & Development: Coreymillia
Inspired by: Joust (Williams Electronics, 1982)

description_src:
k85OS v4.0 - что изменилось
Новая функциональность
Store - система установки/удаления игр

Вкладка Install - показывает только НЕ установленные игры из магазина
Вкладка Uninstall - показывает только УЖЕ установленные игры
После установки игра сразу появляется в новой вкладке Games в главном меню
После удаления игра убирается из Games и стирается её рекорд
Вкладка Games

Появляется в главном меню автоматически, когда есть хотя бы одна установленная игра
Показывает список установленных игр с их текущими рекордами
B - запустить игру
Выход из игр зажатием A+B

Во всех играх (2048, Tetris, Snake, Memory, Reaction, Flappy, Balance)
При выходе рекорд сохраняется (если игра не закончена Game Over)
Reset All (Settings)

Полный сброс к заводскому состоянию: удаляет JSON-конфиг, обнуляет темы, рекорды, установленные игры, WiFi
После сброса - автоматическая перезагрузка
Исправления
Snake - починен

Раньше нажатие A завершало игру с сохранением рекорда
Теперь A отдельно ничего не делает - управление только через IMU (наклон)
Выход - только A+B или Game Over
Terminal -исправлен баг

Переменная now использовалась до объявления, из-за чего двойной клик A на выход мог работать некорректно
run_list_menu - стабильнее

Добавлена задержка после A+B, чтобы не было ложных срабатываний
Архитектура
Все настройки, рекорды и список установленных игр -в едином JSON (k85os_config.json)
factory_reset() удаляет файл конфига полностью -чистая ОС при следующей загрузке
Внутренняя версия ядра: v4.0 Нумерация релизов ОС: 10-й релиз

name: KProx HID Control, Automation & Proxy
description:
KProx turns an M5Stack Cardputer into a one-button programmable BLE + USB keyboard, boot protocol/HID boot interface and mouse. No software required on the target. Control it via a web interface or REST API over WiFi. Automation sequences are written in a built-in DSL or KProx Script. Credentials are stored in an on-device KeePass KDBX 3.1 database and injected during playback. KProx features menagerie of "apps" such as an IRC client, Nostr Client, TOTP manager and more.

Quick start: https://github.com/akoerner/kprox/blob/master/quick_start.md 

Source: https://github.com/akoerner/kprox

一款运行在 M5Cardputer ADV 上的交互式六爻起卦、解卦工具。
## 功能
- **数字起卦**：输入任意三位数，自动生成上下卦与动爻
- **掷铜钱动画**：3 枚铜钱同步旋转 + 真实铜钱音效
- **六爻显化**：逐爻显化，右侧爻条实时更新
- **解卦结果**：本卦/变卦/方向提示/卦象白话解读（4页）
- **64 卦完整数据**：卦名、卦辞、爻辞、六爻全部收录
- **8 类事由匹配**：事业/财运/感情/健康/学业/出行/家宅/其他
## 操作
| 按键 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | 确认 / 起卦 / 解卦 / 翻页 |
| `;/↑` | 上移 |
| `,/.` | 上/下一页（解卦结果） |
| `Bksp` | 返回 |
| 摇动机身 | 等同于摇一摇 |
## 技术说明
- 字体：思源黑体 Medium 16px（VLW 格式嵌入）
- 音效：22050Hz 16bit PCM 嵌入式播放
- Flash：~831KB（含字库 + 音效 + 64卦数据）
## 硬件
- M5Stack Cardputer ADV（ESP32-S3）

name: Live NOAA GOES Satellite Viewer for your CORE1
description:
A live NOAA GOES satellite weather image viewer for the M5Stack Core 1 (Basic). Connects to your WiFi via a captive portal setup screen, fetches and displays the latest GOES GeoColor satellite image every 5 minutes directly from NOAA's public CDN — no API key required. UTC clock displayed in the bottom-right corner.

🌐 Captive portal setup — WiFi and camera selection via your phone or PC browser on first boot
📡 6 NOAA GOES satellite views selectable from the portal or with a button press
🔄 Auto-refreshes every 5 minutes (NOAA update frequency)
🕐 UTC clock in the bottom-right corner, synced via NTP
💾 Persistent settings — WiFi credentials and camera choice saved to flash, survive reboots
🔘 BtnC cycles cameras without going back to the portal
🔁 Hold BtnA on boot to reopen the setup portal and change settings!<-------- If you screw up typing in or need to change the wifi.

First Boot Setup
On first boot (or after holding BtnA on startup), the device creates an open WiFi access point:

On your phone or PC, connect to the WiFi network:

WeatherCore_Setup
THIS IS A CAPTIVE PORTAL, IT SHOULD OPEN AUTOMATICALLY WHEN YOU HIT CONNECT. IF IT DOES NOT WORK, TURN OFF MOBILE DATA AND FOLLOW DIRECTIONS BELOW.
Open your browser and go to:

192.168.4.1
On most phones a browser page opens automatically (captive portal)
Either way. You must connect to wifi for this to work.  The portal will close once you hit save. You must reboot and hold button A or the left button while it is booting up to get the portal to re open.  
Fill in the form:

WiFi Network Name — your 2.4 GHz network SSID
WiFi Password — leave blank for open networks
NOAA Satellite View — choose from the dropdown
Tap Save & Connect. The portal closes, the device connects to your WiFi, and the satellite image appears within a few seconds.

⚠️ ESP32 supports 2.4 GHz WiFi only. 5 GHz networks will not appear.

Changing Settings After First Boot
Action	How
Reopen setup portal	Hold BtnA (left button) within 3 seconds of powering on
Cycle camera view	Press BtnC (right button) while the image is displayed
Camera selections are saved to flash immediately — the new view persists across reboots.

Satellite Views
View	Satellite	Coverage
GOES-East CONUS (default)	GOES-16	Full continental US, eastern focus
GOES-West CONUS	GOES-18	Full continental US, western focus
Eastern US	GOES-19	Eastern seaboard + Appalachians
Gulf of Mexico	GOES-19	Gulf Coast, Mexico, Central America
Caribbean	GOES-19	Gulf of Mexico + Caribbean Sea
Alaska	GOES-18	Alaska region
All views use NOAA GeoColor imagery — free, public, updated every ~5 minutes, no authentication required.


Created by Coreymillia from the original project WeatherPanel by moononournation

name: M5 Atom S3 - Companion v4 - Satellite Surface
description:
A compact, single-button satellite surface built for Companion v4 using the M5 AtomS3. Supports external RGB rear LED, full-screen bitmap mode, and a new high-visibility text mode with extra-large fonts for simple labels. Includes WiFi config portal, OTA updates, and automatic MAC-based device ID. Perfect for on-stage triggers, tally, timers, and status displays.

Features

Uses the M5 AtomS3 (ESP32-S3 / 0.85″ 128×128 display)

Two selectable display modes:
• Bitmap mode – full-screen rendering of Companion’s 72×72 bitmaps (upscaled)
• Text mode – fast, low-latency text with COLOR/TEXTCOLOR support

Extra-big font for 1–2 characters

Ultra-large font for 3 characters

Large font for 4–6 characters

Multi-line auto-wrapped text for longer labels

External RGB LED on G8/G5/G6 with G7 as Ground (mirrors key colour)

WiFiManager config portal (hold button for 5 seconds)

OTA firmware updates (ArduinoOTA)

Auto deviceID: “AtomS3_XXXXXX” (from full MAC)

Companion v4 Satellite API: TEXT, KEY-STATE, COLOR/TEXTCOLOR, BRIGHTNESS, PING

v1.3 TEXT mode no longer requests bitmaps, reducing traffic and improving responsiveness

Hardware Connections
G8 – LED Red
G5 – LED Green
G6 – LED Blue
G7 – LED Ground
(Use a common-cathode RGB LED with G7 as ground.)

Installation & Usage

Flash firmware to the AtomS3.

On boot the device shows a startup screen, then “Waiting for Companion…”.

In Companion v4, go to Surfaces → Add Device → enter the displayed deviceID.

Hold the front button for 5 seconds to open the WiFi config portal.
(SSID = deviceID)

Configure Companion IP/port and choose display mode (bitmap or text).

Press the button to trigger the assigned action.
The external LED mirrors the Companion key’s colour.

In TEXT mode, set TEXT and COLOR/TEXTCOLOR in Companion — the device renders automatically.

Troubleshooting

LED colours wrong → Confirm wiring; must be common-cathode (G7 = Ground).

Not connecting → Check Companion IP/port and ensure both devices are on the same network.

Text shows only one letter → Update to v1.3, which fixes text rendering and removes bitmap fallback.

Version History
v1.3 – New text-only behaviour, no bitmap requests, faster rendering, improved font scaling.
v1.2 – General stability and UI tweaks.
v1.1 – Fixed LED PWM output.

name: M5 Cardputer Environmental Monitoring with BME 680 gas sensor
description:
See: https://www.blogger.com/blog/post/edit/4759435067747297899/3827130560033440934
This software is for the M5 Cardputer (original, but should work on the “advanced” model) and is an environmental monitoring system, saving data to an SD card and displaying it nicely on a webpage.

This software is for the M5 Cardputer (original, but should work on the “advanced” model) and is an environmental monitoring system, saving data to an SD card and displaying it nicely on a webpage.

It uses the BME 680 sensor, connected via the I2C for remote environmental monitoring. The cardputer is set up as a Webserver so that current readings can be seen on a webpage.

This software project is unfinished, but all the main features work well and survive a 24 hour soak test. I hope others can build on it! The code is weakly commented, but I hope it is readable.

Readings of pressure, temp and humidity are taken every minute (frequency not currently configurable) and saved in memory and to a CSV file, stored on the SD card, if one is present. The file is named based on the current date and a new CSV file is created at midnight.

On the home page, you can click the “Data and Charts” button which will allow you to view the last 24 hours of data and adjust the viewing start and end times for a nice graphical display.

Any CSV files saved on the SD card can be downloaded to your local machine.

Another page allows you to configure operational parameters for high and low alarms for temperature, pressure and humidity. An alarm sound is played from a WAV file through the cardputer’s speaker and an indication of the alarm is given on the home page.

The Cardputer’s display can show each of the environmental values in turn when you press any key, along with the device’s IP address on the network, once it is connected. The local time is determined by connecting to an NTP server.

The code is built from various examples given on the M5Stack website and forums as well as some other places.

The cardputer software uses 2 HTML files from the root folder of the SD card – “index.html” and “charts without data.html” These have placeholders for various bits of data such that the cardputer software fills them in with the relevant data. The chart data stored in memory is sent as a Javascript array so that the web page, when rendered, shows all the chart data. The chart display code was written by Chatgpt and modified a little to produce the relevant display, with start and end time zoom sliders!

I hope someone uses it to monitor their greenhouse or something!

Of course, you can set up port forwarding on your router and keep an eye on your greenhouse remotely!

Enjoy!

Andrew Johnson Dec 2025

name: M5 INTEL
description:
本次修改内容｜中文
接收普通信息时增加可靠提示音。
语音消息使用 WAV 播放链路生成提示音，避免 tone() 接口在 M5StickS3 上不稳定。
QUICK INTEL、STATUS CODE、NUMERIC INTEL、TELEMETRY 和 IMU SIGNAL 收到时播放短提示音。
语音消息收到时播放语音专用提示音。
BEACON 保持静默，不打扰用户。
SOS 保持完全无声，只显示红色紧急警报页面。
简化按键逻辑：菜单页长按 BtnA：切换频道。
功能页长按 BtnA：返回主菜单。
移除原先 A+B 长按返回/切换频道逻辑。

已重新编译并烧录到 COM11、COM27。
两台设备均完成 Hash 校验。
Modified Contents｜English
Added reliable notification sounds for incoming normal messages.
Notification tones now use the WAV playback path instead of the lightweight tone() helper for better M5StickS3 reliability.
QUICK INTEL, STATUS CODE, NUMERIC INTEL, TELEMETRY, and IMU SIGNAL messages play a short notification sound.
Incoming voice messages use a dedicated voice notification sound.
BEACON remains silent and runs in the background.
SOS remains completely silent and only shows the red emergency alert screen.
Simplified button logic:Long-press BtnA on the main menu: change channel.
Long-press BtnA inside any feature: return to the main menu.
The previous A+B long-press return/channel behavior has been removed.

Rebuilt and flashed to COM11 and COM27.
Hash verification passed on both devices.
———————————————————————————————
产品简介

M5 INTEL 是为 M5StickS3 开发的离线近距离情报通信固件。设备通过 ESP-NOW 直接通信，不依赖手机、电脑、Wi-Fi 路由器或互联网。它将临时语音、预设短报文、状态代码、数字情报、设备遥测、IMU 手势信号、定时信标和 SOS 警报整合进一套竖屏赛博终端界面。

当前版本号：v1.0.0  
目标硬件：M5StickS3 / ESP32-S3-PICO-1 / 8 MB Flash  
通信方式：ESP-NOW，同频道设备直接通信  
固件类型：完整合并镜像，从 0x00000000 烧录

### 主要功能

1. M5 TALK
   - 使用内置麦克风录制语音。
   - 最长录音时间为 8 秒。
   - 屏幕实时显示录音时长。
   - 录音完成后可靠发送给同频道设备。
   - 接收端通过全局弹窗显示发送者和语音时长。
   - BtnB 播放语音，BtnA 确认并从内存销毁。

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - 支持发送 00–99 的数字情报。
   - 可用于人数、目标、距离、房间或任务编号。

5. TELEMETRY
   - 发送本机电量百分比。
   - 发送设备开机运行时间。

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - 通过明显摇动设备发送手势信号。
   - 约 2.5g 触发阈值。
   - 15 秒冷却时间，避免重复触发。
   - 录音期间暂停检测。

7. BEACON
   - 每 30 秒发送在线状态和电量。
   - 仅在发现同频道设备且未录音时发送。
   - 后台运行，不弹出干扰窗口。

8. SOS
   - 发送高优先级紧急警报。
   - 接收端显示独立红色 SOS 页面。
   - 播放一次短提示音。
   - BtnB 确认并解除警报。

### UI 与消息体验

- Matrix 风格绿色数字雨启动动画。
- 像素赛博风 M5 INTEL Logo。
- 黑色背景、绿色信息、红色警报。
- 全部功能采用竖屏布局。
- 离屏双缓冲绘制，降低屏幕频闪。
- 显示当前频道和在线设备数量。
- 普通消息和语音可在任意功能页面接收。
- 消息以全局弹窗显示，长内容自动分行。
- 关闭弹窗后返回接收前所在页面。
- 定时信标不弹窗，不打断操作。

### 可靠传输

- 语音降采样后分片传输。
- 数据包包含消息 ID、分片序号、总分片数、时长和 CRC16。
- 接收端逐片返回 ACK。
- 发送端只补发缺失分片，最多执行 5 轮选择性重传。
- 预设报文、状态、数字、遥测、IMU 和 SOS 同样等待接收确认。
- DELIVERED 表示对端已经确认。
- NOT CONFIRMED 表示未获得完整确认，需要重试。
- 重复消息自动去重，不完整语音超时清理。

### 操作方式

主菜单：

- BtnA：向下选择。
- BtnB：进入功能。
- A+B 长按：切换频道。

子功能：

- A+B 长按：返回主菜单。

M5 TALK：

- BtnA：开始或停止录音。
- BtnB：发送本地录音。
- 收到语音弹窗后，BtnB 播放，BtnA 确认并销毁。

普通消息弹窗：

- BtnA：确认并关闭。

### M5Burner 安装

文件：`M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. 在 M5Burner 中选择适用于 M5StickS3 的自定义固件烧录功能。
2. 选择上述 `.bin` 文件。
3. 烧录地址设置为 `0x00000000`。
4. 建议首次安装前执行 Erase Flash。
5. 选择设备对应串口并开始烧录。
6. 两台设备必须安装相同版本并设置为相同频道。

### 技术边界

- 当前只面向 M5StickS3 设备之间的通信。
- 不连接 Android、iPhone 或原版 Bitchat 手机客户端。
- M5 TALK 是“录制后发送”，不是实时连续语音流。

### Overview

M5 INTEL is an offline, short-range field intelligence firmware for the M5StickS3. Devices communicate directly over ESP-NOW without a phone, computer, Wi-Fi router, or Internet connection. It combines temporary voice messages, preset reports, status codes, numeric intelligence, telemetry, IMU gesture signals, periodic beacons, and SOS alerts in a portrait cyber-terminal interface.

Version: v1.0.0  
Target hardware: M5StickS3 / ESP32-S3-PICO-1 / 8 MB Flash  
Transport: direct ESP-NOW communication between devices on the same channel  
Image type: merged flash image for offset 0x00000000

### Main Features

1. M5 TALK
   - Records voice with the built-in microphone.
   - Maximum recording length: 8 seconds.
   - Displays the live recording duration.
   - Reliably transmits completed recordings to same-channel devices.
   - The receiver shows a global popup with sender identity and duration.
   - BtnB plays the voice message; BtnA confirms and removes it from memory.

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - Sends numeric intelligence from 00 to 99.
   - Numbers may represent personnel, targets, distance, rooms, or mission IDs.

5. TELEMETRY
   - Sends battery percentage.
   - Sends device uptime.

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - Sends a gesture signal when the device is shaken firmly.
   - Approximate trigger threshold: 2.5g.
   - A 15-second cooldown prevents repeated triggers.
   - Detection is suspended while recording.

7. BEACON
   - Broadcasts presence and battery level every 30 seconds.
   - Operates only when another same-channel device is detected and no recording is active.
   - Runs silently in the background without interrupting the UI.

8. SOS
   - Sends a high-priority emergency alert.
   - The receiver displays a dedicated red SOS screen.
   - A short notification tone is played once.
   - BtnB acknowledges and closes the alert.

### Interface and Message Experience

- Matrix-inspired green digital-rain boot animation.
- Pixel cyber-style M5 INTEL wordmark.
- Black background, green information, and red emergency alerts.
- Portrait interface throughout the firmware.
- Off-screen buffered rendering to reduce visible flicker.
- Current channel and online device count are displayed.
- Voice and intelligence messages can be received from any feature screen.
- Global popups display the complete sender and message, with automatic line wrapping.
- Closing a popup returns the user to the previous screen.
- Periodic beacons stay in the background and do not open popups.

### Reliable Delivery

- Voice is downsampled and split into ESP-NOW fragments.
- Packets include a message ID, fragment index, fragment count, duration, and CRC16.
- The receiver acknowledges every valid fragment.
- The sender selectively retransmits only missing fragments for up to five rounds.
- Quick reports, status codes, numbers, telemetry, IMU signals, and SOS messages also wait for receiver acknowledgement.
- DELIVERED means the receiver confirmed delivery.
- NOT CONFIRMED means complete confirmation was not received and the user should retry.
- Duplicate messages are filtered and incomplete voice assemblies expire automatically.

### Controls

Main menu:

- BtnA: move down.
- BtnB: enter the selected feature.
- Hold A+B: change the ESP-NOW channel.

Inside a feature:

- Hold A+B: return to the main menu.

M5 TALK:

- BtnA: start or stop recording.
- BtnB: send the local recording.
- In an incoming voice popup, BtnB plays and BtnA confirms and destroys the message.

Standard message popup:

- BtnA: acknowledge and close.

### Installing with M5Burner

File: `M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. Open the custom firmware flashing workflow for M5StickS3 in M5Burner.
2. Select the `.bin` file above.
3. Set the flash offset to `0x00000000`.
4. Erase Flash is recommended before the first installation.
5. Select the correct serial port and start flashing.
6. Both devices must run the same firmware version and use the same channel.

Important: this is a complete merged image containing the bootloader, partition table, boot_app0, and application. Do not flash this file at `0x10000`.

### Current Technical Scope

- This release targets direct communication between M5StickS3 devices.
- It does not connect to Android, iPhone, or the original Bitchat mobile client.
- M5 TALK uses record-then-send voice messages, not continuous live audio streaming.
- ESP-NOW broadcast link encryption is not enabled in this release.
- “Destroy after playback” means deletion from runtime memory; it is not a security-audited physical data-erasure mechanism.
- The current acknowledgement design is primarily intended for reliable two-device operation on one channel.

   - BtnB 播放语音，BtnA 确认并从内存销毁。

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - 支持发送 00–99 的数字情报。
   - 可用于人数、目标、距离、房间或任务编号。

5. TELEMETRY
   - 发送本机电量百分比。
   - 发送设备开机运行时间。

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - 通过明显摇动设备发送手势信号。
   - 约 2.5g 触发阈值。
   - 15 秒冷却时间，避免重复触发。
   - 录音期间暂停检测。

7. BEACON
   - 每 30 秒发送在线状态和电量。
   - 仅在发现同频道设备且未录音时发送。
   - 后台运行，不弹出干扰窗口。

8. SOS
   - 发送高优先级紧急警报。
   - 接收端显示独立红色 SOS 页面。
   - 播放一次短提示音。
   - BtnB 确认并解除警报。

### UI 与消息体验

- Matrix 风格绿色数字雨启动动画。
- 像素赛博风 M5 INTEL Logo。
- 黑色背景、绿色信息、红色警报。
- 全部功能采用竖屏布局。
- 离屏双缓冲绘制，降低屏幕频闪。
- 显示当前频道和在线设备数量。
- 普通消息和语音可在任意功能页面接收。
- 消息以全局弹窗显示，长内容自动分行。
- 关闭弹窗后返回接收前所在页面。
- 定时信标不弹窗，不打断操作。

### 可靠传输

- 语音降采样后分片传输。
- 数据包包含消息 ID、分片序号、总分片数、时长和 CRC16。
- 接收端逐片返回 ACK。
- 发送端只补发缺失分片，最多执行 5 轮选择性重传。
- 预设报文、状态、数字、遥测、IMU 和 SOS 同样等待接收确认。
- DELIVERED 表示对端已经确认。
- NOT CONFIRMED 表示未获得完整确认，需要重试。
- 重复消息自动去重，不完整语音超时清理。

### 操作方式

主菜单：

- BtnA：向下选择。
- BtnB：进入功能。
- A+B 长按：切换频道。

子功能：

- A+B 长按：返回主菜单。

M5 TALK：

- BtnA：开始或停止录音。
- BtnB：发送本地录音。
- 收到语音弹窗后，BtnB 播放，BtnA 确认并销毁。

普通消息弹窗：

- BtnA：确认并关闭。

### M5Burner 安装

文件：`M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. 在 M5Burner 中选择适用于 M5StickS3 的自定义固件烧录功能。
2. 选择上述 `.bin` 文件。
3. 烧录地址设置为 `0x00000000`。
4. 建议首次安装前执行 Erase Flash。
5. 选择设备对应串口并开始烧录。
6. 两台设备必须安装相同版本并设置为相同频道。

注意：这是完整合并镜像，已经包含 Bootloader、分区表、boot_app0 和应用程序。不要把该文件烧录到 `0x10000`。

### 技术边界

- 当前只面向 M5StickS3 设备之间的通信。
- 不连接 Android、iPhone 或原版 Bitchat 手机客户端。
- M5 TALK 是“录制后发送”，不是实时连续语音流。
- 当前 ESP-NOW 广播未启用链路加密。
- “播放后销毁”表示从运行内存中删除，不等同于经过安全审计的物理数据擦除。
- 当前 ACK 逻辑主要针对两台同频道设备的可靠通信场景。

---

### Overview

M5 INTEL is an offline, short-range field intelligence firmware for the M5StickS3. Devices communicate directly over ESP-NOW without a phone, computer, Wi-Fi router, or Internet connection. It combines temporary voice messages, preset reports, status codes, numeric intelligence, telemetry, IMU gesture signals, periodic beacons, and SOS alerts in a portrait cyber-terminal interface.

Version: v1.0.0  
Target hardware: M5StickS3 / ESP32-S3-PICO-1 / 8 MB Flash  
Transport: direct ESP-NOW communication between devices on the same channel  
Image type: merged flash image for offset 0x00000000

### Main Features

1. M5 TALK
   - Records voice with the built-in microphone.
   - Maximum recording length: 8 seconds.
   - Displays the live recording duration.
   - Reliably transmits completed recordings to same-channel devices.
   - The receiver shows a global popup with sender identity and duration.
   - BtnB plays the voice message; BtnA confirms and removes it from memory.

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - Sends numeric intelligence from 00 to 99.
   - Numbers may represent personnel, targets, distance, rooms, or mission IDs.

5. TELEMETRY
   - Sends battery percentage.
   - Sends device uptime.

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - Sends a gesture signal when the device is shaken firmly.
   - Approximate trigger threshold: 2.5g.
   - A 15-second cooldown prevents repeated triggers.
   - Detection is suspended while recording.

7. BEACON
   - Broadcasts presence and battery level every 30 seconds.
   - Operates only when another same-channel device is detected and no recording is active.
   - Runs silently in the background without interrupting the UI.

8. SOS
   - Sends a high-priority emergency alert.
   - The receiver displays a dedicated red SOS screen.
   - A short notification tone is played once.
   - BtnB acknowledges and closes the alert.

### Interface and Message Experience

- Matrix-inspired green digital-rain boot animation.
- Pixel cyber-style M5 INTEL wordmark.
- Black background, green information, and red emergency alerts.
- Portrait interface throughout the firmware.
- Off-screen buffered rendering to reduce visible flicker.
- Current channel and online device count are displayed.
- Voice and intelligence messages can be received from any feature screen.
- Global popups display the complete sender and message, with automatic line wrapping.
- Closing a popup returns the user to the previous screen.
- Periodic beacons stay in the background and do not open popups.

### Reliable Delivery

- Voice is downsampled and split into ESP-NOW fragments.
- Packets include a message ID, fragment index, fragment count, duration, and CRC16.
- The receiver acknowledges every valid fragment.
- The sender selectively retransmits only missing fragments for up to five rounds.
- Quick reports, status codes, numbers, telemetry, IMU signals, and SOS messages also wait for receiver acknowledgement.
- DELIVERED means the receiver confirmed delivery.
- NOT CONFIRMED means complete confirmation was not received and the user should retry.
- Duplicate messages are filtered and incomplete voice assemblies expire automatically.

### Controls

Main menu:

- BtnA: move down.
- BtnB: enter the selected feature.
- Hold A+B: change the ESP-NOW channel.

Inside a feature:

- Hold A+B: return to the main menu.

M5 TALK:

- BtnA: start or stop recording.
- BtnB: send the local recording.
- In an incoming voice popup, BtnB plays and BtnA confirms and destroys the message.

Standard message popup:

- BtnA: acknowledge and close.

### Installing with M5Burner

File: `M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. Open the custom firmware flashing workflow for M5StickS3 in M5Burner.
2. Select the `.bin` file above.
3. Set the flash offset to `0x00000000`.
4. Erase Flash is recommended before the first installation.
5. Select the correct serial port and start flashing.
6. Both devices must run the same firmware version and use the same channel.

Important: this is a complete merged image containing the bootloader, partition table, boot_app0, and application. Do not flash this file at `0x10000`.

### Current Technical Scope

- This release targets direct communication between M5StickS3 devices.
- It does not connect to Android, iPhone, or the original Bitchat mobile client.
- M5 TALK uses record-then-send voice messages, not continuous live audio streaming.
- ESP-NOW broadcast link encryption is not enabled in this release.
- “Destroy after playback” means deletion from runtime memory; it is not a security-audited physical data-erasure mechanism.
- The current acknowledgement design is primarily intended for reliable two-device operation on one channel.

description:
M5Cardputer Album Cover MP3 Player
（请下载最新的V1.1，原先的V1.0因为我上传错固件了，会导致黑屏）
Features & User Guide
1. Overview
An embedded MP3 player for M5Cardputer (ESP32-S3). Built with arduino-audio-tools, ES8311 codec and NS4150 amplifier. Supports ID3 album art, multi-folder management, precise playback progress and smooth volume control. Works with standard CBR/VBR MP3 files, no popping noise during track switching.
2. Hardware & Dependencies
Mainboard: M5Cardputer (ESP32-S3)
Audio Codec: ES8311 (I2C: 0x18 | SDA=GPIO38, SCL=GPIO39; I2S: BCLK=GPIO41, WS=GPIO43, DOUT=GPIO42)
Amplifier: NS4150 (Auto mute when headphones plugged in)
Storage: Micro SD Card (SPI)
Libraries: M5Cardputer.h, SD.h, JPEGDEC.h, arduino-audio-tools
3. Core Functions
Playback
Supports 16-bit stereo MP3 (44.1kHz/48kHz). Reads XING/VBRI headers for accurate duration. Features play/pause, previous/next track and folder loop. Buffer flush prevents audio truncation.
Album Cover
Loads ID3v2 APIC art (JPG/PNG). Caches covers locally on first boot. Displays No Cover if no artwork exists.
File Management
Scans /mp3 subfolders. Max: 64 folders, 64 tracks per folder. Supports page browsing.
Audio Optimization
25-level volume with human-perception curve. ES8311 soft mute eliminates pops. Auto-adapts to different sample rates.
On-screen Display
Album cover, auto-wrap song name, progress bar, play status, track number, volume, sample rate, remaining time & battery level.
Extra
Key debounce, automatic memory management, progress resume after pause.
4. SD Card Rules
Format SD card to FAT32. Create a root folder named mp3, then put music into its subfolders:
plaintext
SD Root
└── mp3
    ├── Folder1
    │   ├── Track1.mp3
    │   └── ...
    └── Folder2
Only 1st-level subfolders are supported.
Use English/Chinese names, avoid special characters.
Embedded ID3 cover will be cached as cover.jpg/cover.png.
5. Key Operations
Folder List Page
Q / W / , / ; : Switch up
A / S / . / / : Switch down
Enter: Open folder & play
Player Page
Space: Play / Pause
. : Previous track
; : Next track
/ = : Volume up
: Volume down
B / Backspace: Stop & return to folder list
Notes: Tracks loop at folder end. All keys with anti-repeat protection.
6. Usage Steps
Organize SD files and connect hardware.
Power on: Scanning SD... → Caching covers...
Select folder and press Enter to play.
Press B/Backspace to exit playback.
7. Troubleshooting
SD Card Failed: Reinsert SD or reformat to FAT32.
No MP3 Folders: Check /mp3 directory structure.
No cover: Embed ID3 art via MP3Tag/Foobar; delete cache files and reboot.
Noise: Check wiring or lower volume.
Progress offset: Minor deviation on old VBR files is normal.
Speaker no sound: Unplug headphones and check amplifier.
8. Additional Notes
Recommended format: 44.1kHz 16-bit stereo MP3.
Cover file ≤ 1MB for fast loading.
Stable for long-time continuous playback.

M5Cardputer 专辑封面 MP3 播放器
功能说明 & 使用指南
一、概述
基于 M5Cardputer（ESP32-S3）开发的嵌入式 MP3 播放器，搭配arduino-audio-tools音频库、ES8311 音频解码芯片与 NS4150 功放。支持 ID3 专辑封面、多文件夹管理、精准播放进度与人性化音量调节，兼容标准 CBR/VBR 格式 MP3，切歌无爆音。
二、硬件与依赖
主控：M5Cardputer（ESP32-S3）
音频解码：ES8311（I2C 地址 0x18，SDA=GPIO38、SCL=GPIO39；I2S：BCLK=GPIO41、WS=GPIO43、DOUT=GPIO42）
功放：NS4150（插入耳机自动关闭外放）
存储：Micro SD 卡（SPI 通信）
依赖库：M5Cardputer.h、SD.h、JPEGDEC.h、arduino-audio-tools
三、核心功能
播放功能
支持 44.1kHz/48kHz 16 位立体声 MP3，解析音频头精准计算时长。具备播放 / 暂停、上一曲 / 下一曲、文件夹内循环功能，缓冲区优化，杜绝音频截断。
专辑封面
读取 ID3v2 内嵌 JPG/PNG 封面，首次使用自动缓存图片；无封面时显示默认占位图。
文件管理
自动扫描 SD 卡mp3目录下子文件夹，最多支持 64 个文件夹、单文件夹 64 首歌曲，支持分页浏览。
音频优化
25 级音量调节，采用人耳感知曲线；ES8311 软静音设计，启停 / 切歌无杂音；自动适配不同音频采样率。
屏幕显示
实时展示专辑封面、自动换行歌曲名、播放进度条、播放状态、曲目序号、音量、采样率、剩余时长、电池电量。
附加功能
按键防误触、内存自动管理、暂停后记忆播放进度。
四、SD 卡目录规则
SD 卡格式化为 FAT32，在根目录新建mp3文件夹，音乐存放至其子目录：
plaintext
SD卡根目录
└── mp3
    ├── 文件夹1
    │   ├── 歌曲.mp3
    │   └── ...
    └── 文件夹2
仅识别mp3下一级子文件夹，不支持多层目录
文件夹 / 名称支持中英文，请勿使用特殊符号
内嵌封面会自动缓存为cover.jpg/cover.png
五、按键操作
文件夹列表页
Q / W / , / ; ：向上切换文件夹
A / S /.// ：向下切换文件夹
回车键 ：进入文件夹并开始播放
播放界面
空格键 ：播放 / 暂停
. 键 ：上一曲
; 键 ：下一曲
/ = 键 ：音量增大
键 ：音量减小
B / 退格键 ：停止播放，返回文件夹列表
补充：播放至最后一首会自动循环；所有按键均做防重复处理。
六、使用步骤
按规则整理 SD 卡文件，接好硬件；
开机，设备依次执行 SD 卡扫描、封面缓存；
选择文件夹，按回车进入播放；
按下 B / 退格键可退出播放。

Features & User Guide
1. Overview
An embedded MP3 player for M5Cardputer (ESP32-S3). Built with arduino-audio-tools, ES8311 codec and NS4150 amplifier. Supports ID3 album art, multi-folder management, precise playback progress and smooth volume control. Works with standard CBR/VBR MP3 files, no popping noise during track switching.
2. Hardware & Dependencies
Mainboard: M5Cardputer (ESP32-S3)
Audio Codec: ES8311 (I2C: 0x18 | SDA=GPIO38, SCL=GPIO39; I2S: BCLK=GPIO41, WS=GPIO43, DOUT=GPIO42)
Amplifier: NS4150 (Auto mute when headphones plugged in)
Storage: Micro SD Card (SPI)
Libraries: M5Cardputer.h, SD.h, JPEGDEC.h, arduino-audio-tools
3. Core Functions
Playback
Supports 16-bit stereo MP3 (44.1kHz/48kHz). Reads XING/VBRI headers for accurate duration. Features play/pause, previous/next track and folder loop. Buffer flush prevents audio truncation.
Album Cover
Loads ID3v2 APIC art (JPG/PNG). Caches covers locally on first boot. Displays No Cover if no artwork exists.
File Management
Scans /mp3 subfolders. Max: 64 folders, 64 tracks per folder. Supports page browsing.
Audio Optimization
25-level volume with human-perception curve. ES8311 soft mute eliminates pops. Auto-adapts to different sample rates.
On-screen Display
Album cover, auto-wrap song name, progress bar, play status, track number, volume, sample rate, remaining time & battery level.
Extra
Key debounce, automatic memory management, progress resume after pause.
4. SD Card Rules
Format SD card to FAT32. Create a root folder named mp3, then put music into its subfolders:
plaintext
SD Root
└── mp3
    ├── Folder1
    │   ├── Track1.mp3
    │   └── ...
    └── Folder2
Only 1st-level subfolders are supported.
Use English/Chinese names, avoid special characters.
Embedded ID3 cover will be cached as cover.jpg/cover.png.
5. Key Operations
Folder List Page
Q / W / , / ; : Switch up
A / S / . / / : Switch down
Enter: Open folder & play
Player Page
Space: Play / Pause
. : Previous track
; : Next track
/ = : Volume up
: Volume down
B / Backspace: Stop & return to folder list
Notes: Tracks loop at folder end. All keys with anti-repeat protection.
6. Usage Steps
Organize SD files and connect hardware.
Power on: Scanning SD... → Caching covers...
Select folder and press Enter to play.
Press B/Backspace to exit playback.
7. Troubleshooting
SD Card Failed: Reinsert SD or reformat to FAT32.
No MP3 Folders: Check /mp3 directory structure.
No cover: Embed ID3 art via MP3Tag/Foobar; delete cache files and reboot.
Noise: Check wiring or lower volume.
Progress offset: Minor deviation on old VBR files is normal.
Speaker no sound: Unplug headphones and check amplifier.
8. Additional Notes
Recommended format: 44.1kHz 16-bit stereo MP3.
Cover file ≤ 1MB for fast loading.
Stable for long-time continuous playback.

M5Cardputer 专辑封面 MP3 播放器
功能说明 & 使用指南
一、概述
基于 M5Cardputer（ESP32-S3）开发的嵌入式 MP3 播放器，搭配arduino-audio-tools音频库、ES8311 音频解码芯片与 NS4150 功放。支持 ID3 专辑封面、多文件夹管理、精准播放进度与人性化音量调节，兼容标准 CBR/VBR 格式 MP3，切歌无爆音。
二、硬件与依赖
主控：M5Cardputer（ESP32-S3）
音频解码：ES8311（I2C 地址 0x18，SDA=GPIO38、SCL=GPIO39；I2S：BCLK=GPIO41、WS=GPIO43、DOUT=GPIO42）
功放：NS4150（插入耳机自动关闭外放）
存储：Micro SD 卡（SPI 通信）
依赖库：M5Cardputer.h、SD.h、JPEGDEC.h、arduino-audio-tools
三、核心功能
播放功能
支持 44.1kHz/48kHz 16 位立体声 MP3，解析音频头精准计算时长。具备播放 / 暂停、上一曲 / 下一曲、文件夹内循环功能，缓冲区优化，杜绝音频截断。
专辑封面
读取 ID3v2 内嵌 JPG/PNG 封面，首次使用自动缓存图片；无封面时显示默认占位图。
文件管理
自动扫描 SD 卡mp3目录下子文件夹，最多支持 64 个文件夹、单文件夹 64 首歌曲，支持分页浏览。
音频优化
25 级音量调节，采用人耳感知曲线；ES8311 软静音设计，启停 / 切歌无杂音；自动适配不同音频采样率。
屏幕显示
实时展示专辑封面、自动换行歌曲名、播放进度条、播放状态、曲目序号、音量、采样率、剩余时长、电池电量。
附加功能
按键防误触、内存自动管理、暂停后记忆播放进度。
四、SD 卡目录规则
SD 卡格式化为 FAT32，在根目录新建mp3文件夹，音乐存放至其子目录：
plaintext
SD卡根目录
└── mp3
    ├── 文件夹1
    │   ├── 歌曲.mp3
    │   └── ...
    └── 文件夹2
仅识别mp3下一级子文件夹，不支持多层目录
文件夹 / 名称支持中英文，请勿使用特殊符号
内嵌封面会自动缓存为cover.jpg/cover.png
五、按键操作
文件夹列表页
Q / W / , / ; ：向上切换文件夹
A / S /.// ：向下切换文件夹
回车键 ：进入文件夹并开始播放
播放界面
空格键 ：播放 / 暂停
. 键 ：上一曲
; 键 ：下一曲
/ = 键 ：音量增大
键 ：音量减小
B / 退格键 ：停止播放，返回文件夹列表
补充：播放至最后一首会自动循环；所有按键均做防重复处理。
六、使用步骤
按规则整理 SD 卡文件，接好硬件；
开机，设备依次执行 SD 卡扫描、封面缓存；
选择文件夹，按回车进入播放；
按下 B / 退格键可退出播放。

未找到歌曲文件夹：检查 SD 卡mp3目录结构
无专辑封面：使用 MP3Tag、Foobar 等工具内嵌封面，或删除缓存图片后重启
播放有杂音：检查硬件接线，或调低音量
进度有偏差：老旧 VBR 格式 MP3 出现小幅误差属于正常现象
外放无声：拔掉耳机，检查功放硬件

name: M5Cardputer WebRadio FR
description:
M5Cardputer WebRadio FR version
WiFi Settings will be stored in EEPROM
PlatformIO IDE used. (VS code)

Difficult to use an SD card for URL storage: The classic dilemma on ESP32:

Wi-Fi after SPI/SD_card = Wi-Fi fails
SPI/SD after Wi-Fi = SD fails
Why? On some boards like the M5Cardputer, SD access is done via HSPI, while Wi-Fi uses DMA/interrupts from the main bus. → When SD is initialized after Wi-Fi, the SPI bus or GPIO pins may conflict.

Implemented solution: Use an HTTP GET request to retrieve the list of channels: web-streams come from http://philae.synology.me/~admin/arduino/radio_dico.php

description:
THIS IS VERY EASY... AND FREE! For M5StickC Plus2 Only!
M5GroqBot requires a free Groq API key to function. This guide will walk you through getting your key and configuring your device.
-Step 1: Get Your Free API Key
-Create a Groq Account
-Open your web browser on your computer or phone
-Navigate to the Groq Console:
https://console.groq.com/keys
-Sign up for a new Groq account (or log in if you already have one)
-The free tier is automatically available upon sign-up
-No credit card required
-Generous free usage limits
-Generate Your API Key
-Once logged in, you'll see the API Keys page
-Click the "Create API Key" button
-Give your key a descriptive name (e.g., M5GroqBot or M5StickC-Voice)
-Click "Create"
-⚠️ IMPORTANT: Copy the key immediately!
-The key looks like: gsk_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
>>>You won't be able to see it again after closing the dialog<<<
-Store it somewhere safe 

-Step 2: Flash Firmware to Your Device
-Step 3: Connect to Device WiFi Access Point
-After the firmware is flashed and the device restarts:

-Look at the M5StickC screen - it should display:

WiFi Setup...
Connect to:
M5GroqBot-Setup
On your phone or computer:

Open WiFi settings
Look for network named: M5GroqBot-Setup
Connect to it (no password required, if it does ask, it was groqbot123)
Wait for setup page to open automatically

If it doesn't auto-open, manually go to: http://192.168.4.1
Step 4: Configure WiFi and API Key
On the setup page you'll see:

WiFi Network dropdown

Select your home/office WiFi network
Enter the WiFi password
Groq API Key field

Paste your Groq API key here (the one you copied earlier)
Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after
Click "Save"

Device will save settings and restart
Takes about 5-10 seconds
Step 5: First Use
After restart, the device will:

Connect to your WiFi automatically

Displays the ready screen:

READY!
Ask me anything
With simple animation!

Press M5 Button to start recording
Speak your question clearly for 3 seconds
Get instant AI responses!
Scroll down by pressing the PWR button or bottom button
Scroll up by pressing R or top button
HOLD R to change colors of CHAT. 


THINGS YOU SHOULD KNOW.  Work in progress. I will probably update this project... Updated from 2 to 3 seconds recording. Color change settings now stay after reboot.  
I was STILL unable to get it to "continue" back to back questions. So what happens is when you ask a question it will prompt to reinitialize, after scrolling down, it takes just a few seconds to reconnect, its a little annoying. By pressing down just saves you the time of it not recording and then failing and rebooting. If you try to ask it another question it WILL also reconnect, it just takes longer and is a bit confusing as... it should work. 
I am going to still try to fix it. 
 It does not affect the way the chatbot works. It's one question at a time and NO memory at all.
 IF you do not speak clearly it may not do anything when it tries to translate, if it says ERROR Parse Failed it did not hear you.  I think the groq free tier is 30 request per hour. I have not maxed it out testing yet and have done a lot of testing. 

Have fun.

name: M5Paper NTP Master Clock
description:
# M5Paper Clock - Settings Configuration File
# Place this file on your SD card root as: /settings.txt
# Format: KEY=VALUE (one per line)
# Lines starting with # are comments and will be ignored

# Timezone offset from UTC (in hours)
# Examples: -7 = Mountain Time (MST/MDT), -5 = Eastern Time (EST/EDT)
#           0 = UK (GMT/BST), 9 = Japan/Korea (JST/KST)
TIMEZONE=-7

# WiFi Network Credentials
# Replace with your actual WiFi network name and password
WIFI_SSID=YOUR_WIFI_SSID
WIFI_PASSWORD=YOUR_WIFI_PASSWORD

# NTP Time Server
# Recommended servers:
#   time.cloudflare.com (Cloudflare - very reliable, global)
#   pool.ntp.org (Global pool of time servers)
#   time.google.com (Google - very reliable)
#   time.nist.gov (NIST - US government)
NTP_SERVER=time.cloudflare.com

name: M5StackTab5MusicBoxEN
description:
"Music Box Workshop (オルゴール工房)"
This app lets you enjoy making your own hand-cranked music box.
You can experience the feeling of punching holes in the paper of a hand-cranked music box and playing it.
While a real music box requires multiple sheets of paper, this app lets you correct mistakes and start over as many times as you like.
You can also write your own song on the music box's circuit board and give it as a gift, or download it to your smartphone using a QR code.


Key Features
- Transfer song data to the board and play it on the board
- Input from quarter notes to 64th notes
- 256 steps for quarter notes, 4096 steps for 64th notes
- Adjustable playback tempo
- 2-octave keyboard input
- Up to 3 notes per step
- Input up to 250 notes
- Data saving (automatically loaded when the app is restarted)
- Transfer composition data to your smartphone via QR code
- Save and load data to SD card
- Delete previously entered notes by reselecting them
- Automatic scrolling when typing (when scrolling is on)
- Up and down scroll keys (hold to fast forward)
- Set the end of the song with the END button
- Insert and delete one line
- Transfer song data created to a Frisk-sized music box workshop (オルゴール工房) board and play it on the board


How to Use
● Home Screen
Pressing a key will play the corresponding sound and add a mark.
Scrolling advances one note at a time according to the set note value (quarter note to 64th note).
The note value can be changed using the "(+)" and "(-)" buttons on the right.
The editing position can be moved using the "UP" and "DOWN" buttons on the left, and the sound at the moved position will be played.
Pressing and holding the "UP" or "DOWN" buttons will fast-forward. No sound will be played in this case.
Pressing the "SAVE" button will save the edited song to the internal memory and automatically load it the next time the unit is started.
To listen to the song you entered from the beginning, press the "TOP" button to move to the beginning of the song, then press the "PLAY" button.
Playback will automatically stop when it reaches the end of the song.
To stop playback midway, press the "PLAY" button.
Pressing the "INS" button will insert one line (the length of the current note) at the current editing position.
Pressing the "DEL" button will delete one line from the current editing position.
Press the "MENU" button to display the settings menu screen.


●Settings Menu Screen
Pressing the "CLEAR" button twice will clear all composition data.
Pressing the "ONLY PLAY" button to turn it on allows you to freely play without recording.
The "SD SAVE" button saves data to the SD card.
You can add an 8-digit number to the file name.
The "SD LOAD" button loads song data saved on the SD card.
Song data is limited to 100 songs.
Turning on the "AUTO SCROLL" button automatically scrolls one note at a time as you play.
The "VOL" button adjusts the volume.
The "TEMPO" button changes the tempo (30-240).
Pressing the "QR VIEW" button converts the current song data into a QR code and displays it.
Click the "TRANS" button to transfer the composition data to the Music Box Workshop board (オルゴール工房).
It can be loaded using the "オルゴール工房" smartphone app.


●Transferring Song Data to the Board
You can transfer the song data you created to the Music Box Workshop board and play it on the board.
Press the "Transfer" button in the menu to display the song data transfer screen.
Press and hold the button on the board until the LED slowly flashes (write mode).
Place the board's light sensor directly above the light-emitting element and press the "TRANS" button.
While writing, the board's LED will stop flashing and remain lit, and the progress bar will advance.
If the data is successfully written, the board's LED will turn off.
If the data transfer fails, the board's LED will flash rapidly; press the button on the board (to exit write mode) and try again.


To see videos on how to use it, search for "Music Box Workshop (オルゴール工房)" on YouTube.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gKYO2o_FNh4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFtbN6PRWyo
The circuit board is available for purchase on Mercari and Switch Science. Search for "Music Box Workshop (オルゴール工房)".

name: M5StackTab5MusicBoxJP
description:
「オルゴール工房」
手作り手回しオルゴールを楽しめるアプリです。
手回しオルゴールの紙にパンチで穴を空けて演奏してみる感覚を味わえます。
実物では紙が何枚も必要になりますが、このアプリであれば失敗しても何度でも修正してやり直せます。
オルゴール基板に書き込んで自作の曲をプレゼントしたり、QRコードでスマホに取り込むこともできます。

主な特徴
・曲データを基板へ転送して、基板で演奏可能
・4分音符から64分音符まで入力可能
・4分音符で256ステップ、64分音符で4096ステップ
・再生時のテンポ設定可能
・2オクターブ鍵盤入力
・1ステップに3音まで同時発音
・250音まで入力可能
・データ保存（アプリ再開時に自動読み込み）
・QRコードを介してスマホと作曲データのやり取りが可能
・SDカードの保存と読出が可能
・入力済み音を再選択すると消去できます
・入力すると自動スクロールします（スクロールオン時）
・画面上下スクロールキー（長押しで早送り）
・曲の終了位置をENDボタンで設定できます
・1行挿入と1行削除機能
・フリスクサイズのオルゴール工房基板に作成した曲データを転送して基板で演奏できます

使い方
●トップ画面
鍵盤を押すとその音が鳴り、マークが付きます。
スクロールは、設定した音符（4分音符〜64分音符）にしたがって1音分送られます。
音符は、右側の「↑」と「↓」ボタンで変更出来ます。
編集位置は、左側の「↑」と「↓」ボタンで移動でき、移動した位置の音が再生されます。
「↑」と「↓」ボタンは、長押しすると早送りされます。この時は、音は再生しません。
「保存」ボタンを押すと、本体に保存され、次回起動時に自動的に読み込まれます。
打ち込んだ曲を最初から聴くには、「先頭」ボタンを押して曲の先頭に移動し、「演奏」ボタンを押します。
演奏が曲の最後まで来ると自動的に停止します。
途中で止めたいときは、「演奏」ボタンを押します。
「挿入」ボタンを押すと現在の編集位置に1行分（現在の音符の長さ分）挿入します。
「消去」ボタンを押すと現在の編集位置の1行分を削除します。
「設定」ボタンを押すと設定メニュー画面が表示されます。

●設定メニュー画面
「全消去」ボタンは、2回押すと作曲データを全てクリアします。
「フリー演奏」ボタンを押してオンにすると、記録せず自由に演奏を楽しめます。
「SD保存」ボタンでSDカードにデータを保存できます。
保存するファイル名は、8桁の数字を付ける事ができます。
「SD読込」ボタンでSDカードに保存した曲データを読み込めます。
曲データは100曲までの制限があります。
「自動スクロール」ボタンをオンにすると打鍵時に1音分自動でスクロールさせられます。
「音量」ボタンでボリュームを調整できます。
「テンポ」ボタンでテンポを変更できます。（30～240）
「QR表示」ボタンを押すと、現在の曲データをQRコード変換して表示します。
「転送」ボタンでオルゴール工房基板に作曲データを転送できます。
スマホアプリ「オルゴール工房」で読み込むことができます。

●基板への作成曲データ転送
オルゴール工房基板に作成した曲データを転送して基板で演奏することができます。
メニューの「転送」ボタンを押して、曲データの転送画面にします。
基板のボタンを長押しして、LEDがゆっくり点滅（書込モード）にします。
基板の光センサが発光部の真上に来るように置き「転送」ボタンを押します。
書込中は基板のLEDが点滅から点灯に切り替わり、プログレスバーが進行します。
データの書込が成功すると基板のLEDは消灯します。
データの転送に失敗すると基板のLEDが速く点滅するので、基板のボタンを押して（書込モード解除）やり直して下さい。

使い方の動画は、YouTubeで「オルゴール工房」「スマホアプリで電子オルゴール基板への曲データ書き込み」で検索して下さい。
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gKYO2o_FNh4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFtbN6PRWyo
基板は、メルカリとスイッチサイエンスで販売中。「オルゴール工房」で検索して下さい。

description_src:
「オルゴール工房」
手作り手回しオルゴールを楽しめるアプリです。
手回しオルゴールの紙にパンチで穴を空けて演奏してみる感覚を味わえます。
実物では紙が何枚も必要になりますが、このアプリであれば失敗しても何度でも修正してやり直せます。
オルゴール基板に書き込んで自作の曲をプレゼントしたり、QRコードでスマホに取り込むこともできます。

主な特徴
・曲データを基板へ転送して、基板で演奏可能
・4分音符から64分音符まで入力可能
・4分音符で256ステップ、64分音符で4096ステップ
・再生時のテンポ設定可能
・2オクターブ鍵盤入力
・1ステップに3音まで同時発音
・250音まで入力可能
・データ保存（アプリ再開時に自動読み込み）
・QRコードを介してスマホと作曲データのやり取りが可能
・SDカードの保存と読出が可能
・入力済み音を再選択すると消去できます
・入力すると自動スクロールします（スクロールオン時）
・画面上下スクロールキー（長押しで早送り）
・曲の終了位置をENDボタンで設定できます
・1行挿入と1行削除機能
・フリスクサイズのオルゴール工房基板に作成した曲データを転送して基板で演奏できます

使い方
●トップ画面
鍵盤を押すとその音が鳴り、マークが付きます。
スクロールは、設定した音符（4分音符〜64分音符）にしたがって1音分送られます。
音符は、右側の「↑」と「↓」ボタンで変更出来ます。
編集位置は、左側の「↑」と「↓」ボタンで移動でき、移動した位置の音が再生されます。
「↑」と「↓」ボタンは、長押しすると早送りされます。この時は、音は再生しません。
「保存」ボタンを押すと、本体に保存され、次回起動時に自動的に読み込まれます。
打ち込んだ曲を最初から聴くには、「先頭」ボタンを押して曲の先頭に移動し、「演奏」ボタンを押します。
演奏が曲の最後まで来ると自動的に停止します。
途中で止めたいときは、「演奏」ボタンを押します。
「挿入」ボタンを押すと現在の編集位置に1行分（現在の音符の長さ分）挿入します。
「消去」ボタンを押すと現在の編集位置の1行分を削除します。
「設定」ボタンを押すと設定メニュー画面が表示されます。

●設定メニュー画面
「全消去」ボタンは、2回押すと作曲データを全てクリアします。
「フリー演奏」ボタンを押してオンにすると、記録せず自由に演奏を楽しめます。
「SD保存」ボタンでSDカードにデータを保存できます。
保存するファイル名は、8桁の数字を付ける事ができます。
「SD読込」ボタンでSDカードに保存した曲データを読み込めます。
曲データは100曲までの制限があります。
「自動スクロール」ボタンをオンにすると打鍵時に1音分自動でスクロールさせられます。
「音量」ボタンでボリュームを調整できます。
「テンポ」ボタンでテンポを変更できます。（30～240）
「QR表示」ボタンを押すと、現在の曲データをQRコード変換して表示します。
「転送」ボタンでオルゴール工房基板に作曲データを転送できます。
スマホアプリ「オルゴール工房」で読み込むことができます。

●基板への作成曲データ転送
オルゴール工房基板に作成した曲データを転送して基板で演奏することができます。
メニューの「転送」ボタンを押して、曲データの転送画面にします。
基板のボタンを長押しして、LEDがゆっくり点滅（書込モード）にします。
基板の光センサが発光部の真上に来るように置き「転送」ボタンを押します。
書込中は基板のLEDが点滅から点灯に切り替わり、プログレスバーが進行します。
データの書込が成功すると基板のLEDは消灯します。
データの転送に失敗すると基板のLEDが速く点滅するので、基板のボタンを押して（書込モード解除）やり直して下さい。

使い方の動画は、YouTubeで「オルゴール工房」「スマホアプリで電子オルゴール基板への曲データ書き込み」で検索して下さい。
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gKYO2o_FNh4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFtbN6PRWyo
基板は、メルカリとスイッチサイエンスで販売中。「オルゴール工房」で検索して下さい。

name: M5stampclaw
description:
M5stampclaw turns the `M5Stamp S3` into a small AI assistant for embedded tasks.

It can:
- Chat with AI over Telegram or USB serial
- Turn safe GPIO pins on/off and read them
- Remember information across reboots
- Schedule reminders and timed actions
- Report current time, network status, RSSI, and IP
- Scan nearby Wi-Fi networks
- Change reply style/persona

## Example commands

You can talk to it in natural language. Example commands:

```text
Hello
Remember that my name is Jay
Turn on GPIO 5
Show me the current network information
Set a reminder in 10 minutes
```

You can also chain multiple actions in one prompt, for example:

```text
Remember that the pump relay is on GPIO 5. If GPIO 5 is off, turn it on, wait 2 seconds, read it again, then show me the current network info.
```

## First-time setup

There are 2 setup methods:
- Wi-Fi AP + web portal
- USB serial terminal

### 1. Setup over Wi-Fi + web portal

If the board does not have Wi-Fi credentials in NVS, it will automatically start a setup access point on boot:

- SSID: `ESPClaw-Setup-XXXXXX`
- Password: `espclaw1`

After connecting to the AP:
- Open `http://192.168.4.1`
- Fill in the required settings:
  - Wi-Fi SSID
  - Wi-Fi Password
  - LLM Backend
  - API Key
  - Model
  - Base URL (if using a custom endpoint)
  - Telegram Bot Token
  - Telegram Chat ID(s)
- Click `Save And Reboot`

The board will reboot automatically. If Telegram is configured, it will send an initial hello message after reconnecting to Wi-Fi, including a summary of its main capabilities.

### 2. Setup over USB serial

Connect the board to your computer, open a serial monitor, then use commands like:

```text
/config show
/config wifi "My WiFi" "My Password"
/config backend openai
/config apikey sk-...
/config model gpt-4o-mini
/config baseurl https://api.openai.com/v1
/config telegram 123456:ABCDEF -1001234567890
/config reboot
```

Notes:
- If the SSID or password contains spaces, wrap it in quotes.
- `chat_ids` can be a single ID or multiple IDs separated by commas.
- If you do not want Telegram, skip `/config telegram`.

name: Manual Flash Calculator - ATOMS3
description:
v1.0.0:

If you use manual flash in your camera, this will calculate the settings to get the right exposure.

Inputs:

- Tilt left and right: Change the distance from the flash to the subject. Aperture is calculated based on GN, ISO, flash power and distance.
- Double click: Cycles through parameters for editing (GN, ISO, flash power and LCD brightness).
- Single click: Cycles through available values for the parameter that it's currently set for editing. GN from 1 to 64, ISO from 50 to 6400, flash power from 1/128 to full power, and 4 levels of brightness.
- Long click: Locks distance wheel, so you can adjust other settings and see the lens aperture value recalculated.

To save your current GN, ISO, flash power and brightness settings on the non-volatile memory, set the editing box on the brightness indicator and do a long click. This will save your config and reset the device.

v1.1.0:

- Added snap to distance wheel. Click when no other setting is selected and it will cycle through "no snap", 0.25m, 0.5m and 1m snap.

name: Matrix Rain Clock — M5Stack Tab5
description:
A matrix rain cyber-style desktop clock with NTP network time sync and WiFi setup wizard.

**"Red pill or blue pill?"**

For those of us who grew up in the 90s, *The Matrix* wasn't just a movie — it was a revelation. That cascading green rain of code was the first time we saw beauty in data, poetry in programming. It defined a generation's vision of the digital world.

This clock is a love letter to that feeling.

Every time you glance at your desk, the rain falls. The green glow pulses. The seconds tick with NTP precision — not the static time you set by hand, but *the internet's own pulse*, pulled from the sky and written into hardware so it never forgets.

This isn't a clock you configure once and ignore. This is a **time-bringing altar** for your desktop. Each boot is a ceremony: connect to the network, shake hands with the time servers, confirm the moment is true, and only then — let the rain begin.

Built on M5Stack Tab5 (ESP32-P4), 1280×720 MIPI DSI, 30 FPS matrix rain, 6 character sets, direct touch UI, ghost-character glow. No LVGL. No bloat. Just code rain and the exact time, forever.

**For the 80s kids who dreamed of Zion. For the hackers who still believe there is no spoon.**



**"红药丸还是蓝药丸？"**

对于一个 80 后来说，《骇客帝国》不只是电影——那是一场觉醒。绿色的代码雨第一次让我们看见数据的美、编程的诗意。它定义了一代人对数字世界的终极想象。

这个时钟，就是写给那份情怀的一封情书。

每次你看向桌面，雨就在下。绿光在呼吸。秒数在跳动——不是用手调的静态时间，而是*互联网自己的脉搏*，从 NTP 服务器拉下来，写到硬件电池里，永远不忘。

这不是一个调好就吃灰的时钟。这是你桌面上的一座**请时神坛**。每次开机都是一场仪式：连接网络、与时间服务器握手、确认此刻是真实的，然后——雨才开始下。

基于 M5Stack Tab5（ESP32-P4），1280×720 MIPI DSI 屏，30 FPS 矩阵雨，6 套字符集，原生触控 UI，幽灵字符发光。没有 LVGL，没有花哨框架。只有代码雨和时间，永远准确。

**致每一个曾梦见锡安的 80 后少年。致每一个依旧相信"没有勺子"的极客。**
