A turn-based artillery game for the M5StickC Plus2, featuring destructible terrain and tetrimino-styled graphics.

Overview
ScorchedM5 is a Scorched Earth-style artillery game where you face off against an AI opponent. Both players control upside-down T-shaped tetrimino tanks positioned on randomly generated destructible terrain. Take turns adjusting your angle and power to fire projectiles across the map and destroy your opponent.

Features
Destructible Terrain: Randomly generated landscapes with smooth terrain profiles
Turn-based Combat: Adjust angle and power, then fire at your opponent
Physics-based Projectiles: Realistic arc trajectory with gravity
AI Opponent: Computer-controlled enemy with randomized but strategic firing
Animated Sky: Scrolling clouds and tetrimino birds add atmosphere
Win/Loss Tracking: Keep track of your victories and defeats
Tetris-themed Graphics
Controls
M5StickC Plus2 Buttons:
Left Button (PWR): Decrease angle (move aim left)
Right Button (BtnB): Increase angle (move aim right)
M5 (BtnA): Cycle power (1-100%, hold to reverse direction)
Right Button: Fire projectile

Gameplay:
IN THIS ORDER!
1.Adjust your firing angle using Left/Right buttons (in 2.5% increments)
2.Set your power level using M5 button (in 2.5% increments) 
Hold M5 to go in lower increments, press M5 to raise it. 
3.Then press Right button to fire

Watch the projectile arc across the screen
AI takes its turn automatically
First to destroy opponent's tank wins!

Terrain Generation
Randomly generated smooth terrain using sine wave patterns
Different heights and profiles each game

Tank Placement
Tanks spawn on opposite sides of the terrain
Always on solid ground
Random horizontal positions each game
Projectile Physics
Gravity affects trajectory
Angle range: adjustable via buttons

Explosion radius removes terrain blocks
AI Behavior
Calculates approximate trajectory to player
Adds randomization to power and angle
Becomes more accurate as game progresses
Avoids shooting directly off-screen
Win Conditions

💻 M5StickC Plus2 Magic 8-Ball: Optimized & Power-Managed

Project Overview 🪄

This project turns the M5StickC Plus2 into a classic Magic 8-Ball Uses the IMU to simulate the feeling of shaking a Magic 8-ball. Upon shaking, the scrteen will display a random answer. Icludes essential battery monitoring and quick access to time and brightness controls.

✨ Key Features and Power Optimizations

Quick Brightness Control - Button B (Short Press) on the main screen - Cycles brightness from 100 down to 1 (Night Mode)

Low-Flicker Clock/Battery - Automatic, Conditional Redraws - Prevents rapid screen updates and flicker on stable numbers, saving processing power.

Extreme Power Monitoring - Automatic - Battery percentage only updates when a 5% change is detected, drastically reducing redraw frequency.

Time Setup - Button A (Long Press ≥ 2s) - Dedicated, intuitive setup for adjusting the internal RTC clock.

Deep Sleep Mode - Automatic (60-second inactivity) - Maximizes battery life when idle.

🕹️ Controls Guide

Button A

Long Press (2s) - Enters Time Adjustment Mode and in the time set mode on the Time adjustment mode, tap to adjust the digits

Button B

on the main screen, use it to cycle the brightness in 25% increments
on the Time adjustment screen, tap to cycle Hour → Minute → Save → Exit

Shake the device to display a random Magic 8-ball answer~

name: SkyCompass_Satellite
description:
SkyCompass Satellite 是 SkyCompass 项目的扩展演化版本，运行在 M5Stack Cardputer ADV上，目前依赖Cap Lora1262模块获取定位。与原项目关注自然天体（太阳、月亮等）不同，Satellite 版本专注于**人造飞行器（如国际空间站 ISS、天宫空间站、哈勃望远镜等）**的实时轨道追踪与可视性预测。
SkyCompass Satellite is an advanced evolutionary extension of the original SkyCompass project, running on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV (currently relying on the Cap LoRa1262 module for GPS coordinates retrieval).
Unlike the original project which focuses on natural celestial bodies (such as the Sun and Moon), the Satellite edition is dedicated to the real-time orbit tracking and visibility forecasting of artificial space objects (e.g., the International Space Station (ISS), Tiangong Space Station (CSS), Hubble Space Telescope, and more).
- **全景快捷交互与按键映射**：
  - `Enter`：展开/收起近期最佳观测窗口推荐面板。
  - `S` 键：调出卫星复选菜单，自由决定同屏显示的目标。
  - `W` 键：呼出 WiFi 扫描与全键盘密码输入界面。
  - `H` 键：随时在屏幕中央悬浮呼出**快捷键帮助菜单**。
  - `C` 键：进入/退出**手动定位模式 (十字准星模式)**，使用上下左右键手动指定任意观测地点。通过中括号键设置海拔。
  - `[ ]` 键：设置亮度
  - `del` 键：开关数据HUD
  - `R` 键：重置位置和时间
  - `TAB` 键：切换视觉模式
Interactive Hotkeys & Key Bindings:
Enter: Expand or collapse the recommended transit passes panel (shows the best upcoming visibility windows).
S: Open the satellite catalog checkbox menu to choose which satellites to display on screen.
W: Trigger WiFi network scanning and enter your password using the full keyboard.
H: Bring up the floating Keyboard Shortcut Help Menu at the center of the screen.
C: Enter or exit Manual Location Mode (Reticle Crosshair Mode). Use the arrow keys to manually set your coordinates anywhere on Earth, and use the square bracket keys to adjust your altitude.
[ & ]: Adjust screen backlight brightness.
Del: Toggle the HUD telemetry overlay on/off.
R: Reset simulated time and coordinates back to default GPS/GNSS readings.
Tab: Switch between 3D globe visualization modes.
更新记录：
v1.0正式发布
v1.1支持中文语言切换、卫星百科重构、增加更多卫星以及地球同步卫星、还有其他很多重构和优化。目前内存使用率已经很高导致有一些不稳定，使用时注意观察s列表的内存进度条
v1.2网络重构，加速数据下载、减少内存使用
v1.3修复时间转换以及导致计算结果被过滤问题、深空目标轨道计算和显示优化、修复多个崩溃问题、修复chain mono污染IMU读数问题、去除气辉效果、解决世纪前缀硬编码导致最新发射子列表不能正常识别匹配的缺陷
v1.4优化计算状态显示
v1.5IMU读数污染问题优化、推荐过境列表显示优化
Changelog
v1.0 (Official Release)
Initial launch of the SkyCompass Satellite firmware.
v1.1 (Multi-Language & Expansion)
Added Simplified Chinese language switching.
Completely refactored the Satellite Encyclopedia.
Added more target satellites, including geostationary satellites, along with miscellaneous codebase optimizations.
Note: RAM utilization is quite high in this version; please monitor the memory indicator bar in the 'S' menu list.
v1.2 (Network Overhaul)
Rewrote the HTTP/network stack to speed up TLE data downloads while significantly reducing heap memory allocation.
v1.3 (Stability & Trajectory Fixes)
Fixed timezone translation bugs that caused valid transits to be filtered out of the list.
Optimized deep-space target trajectory calculations and screen rendering.
Resolved multiple firmware crash bugs.
Fixed the Chain Mono module's activity polluting IMU sensor I2C readings.
Removed airglow shader effects to improve performance.
Fixed the hardcoded century prefix bug, allowing 1900s launches (e.g., early ISS modules) to correctly parse and display their sub-satellite lists in the Recent Launches panel.
v1.4 (UX Enhancement)
Optimized background calculation indicators. The category headers now turn yellow with a dynamic looping dot animation during background orbital predictions, resolving text layout overflow on English interfaces.

name: Smart Level
description:
智能水平仪固件，支持气泡水平仪、数字角度、目标角度、校准和蜂鸣提示。
Smart Level is a compact digital spirit level firmware for M5StickS3.

It uses the built-in IMU to measure pitch and roll angles, then shows the result on the screen with a bubble-style level, numeric angle display, and target-angle guidance mode.

Features:
- Bubble level view with color feedback
- Numeric pitch and roll angle display
- Current-pose calibration
- Target angle mode from -45° to +45°
- Direction guidance such as LEFT HIGH, RIGHT HIGH, FRONT HIGH, BACK HIGH
- Beep feedback when approaching level or target angle
- Mute / unmute by holding A + B

Controls:
- Press A: calibrate current position as zero
- Press B: switch display mode
- Hold A in Target mode: decrease target angle
- Hold B in Target mode: increase target angle
- Hold A + B: toggle beep on or off

This firmware is useful for adjusting desks, brackets, camera mounts, small machines, shelves, and other surfaces that need quick leveling or angle alignment.

name: Snake Game Cardputer
description:
Snake Cardputer Game 🐍💻

An evolved version of game-snake-m5cardputer from ZrutrA

Game controls

left: "," or left arrow ⬅️

right: "/" or right arrow ➡️

up: ";" or up arrow ⬆️

down: "." or down arrow ⬇️

pause - "p" ⏸️

new game - "n" 🆕

Best score (record)

If an SD memory card is inserted in the device, the largest number of fruit eaten by the snake is stored on this memory. The record will still be visible after the power is restarted. If there is no SD card in the device - the record is reset after each power restart.

How to install a game from a .bin file?

- Via ESPHome

Open <https://web.esphome.io/> in a browser that supports WebSerial (Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge). Click "Connect", select the appropriate port, click "Connect". Then click "Install", point to the snake-M5Cardputer.bin file and click "Install". Ready.

- Via M5Burner

Just find this project in the list, hit "Download" Button and then "Burn" when ready (don't forget to connect to device and select the device COM port).

name: SomaFM Player for Cardputer
description:
SOMA-FM - The BEST radio for Programmers

An internet radio player for the M5Stack Cardputer.
Streams all SomaFM channels. 
Features a custom UI with station logos, genre-colored lists, and live audio visualizers. 
Made with Claude Opus 4.6

Key Features:
On-Device WiFi Setup: Scan and connect to networks directly on the device (no hardcoded credentials).
Audio Visualizers: Cycle through EQ bars, Waveform, and VU meters.
Smart Caching: Uses LittleFS to cache station logos and channel lists for near-instant startup.
Favorites & Persistence: Pin favorite stations to the top and remembers your last station/volume on reboot.
Dual-Core Performance: Gapless MP3 streaming on Core 0 while the UI stays responsive on Core 1.
Hardware Support: Fully compatible with both the original Cardputer and the new Cardputer ADV (ES8311 codec).

Controls
Enter: Play selected station
Space: Pause / Resume
Tab: Cycle Visualizers (Bars / Wave / VU / Off)
W/S or ;/. : Scroll stations (hold to repeat)
F: Toggle Favorite
N: Network/WiFi Setup
Volume: Keys , and /.

name: Sparks
description:
本固件为 Cardputer-ADV 定制个人固件，核心功能包含米家设备控制、Cursor 使用信息查看。

应用清单：
1. 米家（Mijia）｜快捷键：m｜设备状态查看、控制
2. 时钟（Time）｜快捷键：t｜开机时长、实时时间、秒表、倒计时
3. Cursor（Cursor Dashboard）｜快捷键：c｜Cursor 信息查看，TOKEN余量，24小时/7天/30天使用概况
4. 红外（Infrared）｜快捷键：x｜电视、空调红外遥控，适配主流品牌
5. 麦克风（Mic）｜快捷键：r｜麦克风测试、波形查看
6. IMU｜快捷键：g｜BMI270 六轴传感器参数查看
7. WiFi｜快捷键：w｜WiFi 设置，支持多组网络配置切换
8. AP/LAN（Config）｜快捷键：u｜Web配置服务，用于修改 config.json
9. 系统配置（Options）｜快捷键：o｜屏幕、音量等偏好设置
10. 图标查看（Icons）｜快捷键：a｜浏览固件内置图标
11. 字体（Font）｜快捷键：f｜预览系统内置字体
12. 休眠（Sleep）｜快捷键：s｜设备不关机，支持浅休眠、深休眠
13. 摩斯密码（Morse）｜快捷键：j｜按键触发摩斯密码音频输出
14. 键盘（HID Keyboard）｜快捷键：k｜蓝牙、USB HID键盘功能
15. LED（RGB LED）｜快捷键：l｜ESP32板载RGB LED测试
16. 蓝牙（BLE）｜快捷键：b｜扫描并查看周边蓝牙设备列表
17. 屏幕（Display）｜快捷键：d｜屏幕测试，支持多背景色、线条、方块测试

-----  English  ---------

This firmware is a custom personal build tailored for Cardputer-ADV, with core functionalities including local control of Mijia devices and statistics viewing for cursor usage.

Smart Home
m - Mijia: Local LAN-based Mijia device control
Additional entry - Get Device Token: Export token & ble.key via cloud tools and output in config.json format
x - Infrared: IR remote control for TV, air conditioner (GPIO44 pin)

Network & Config
u - Config: Edit firmware config.json via AP hotspot or LAN web page
w - WiFi: Scan, connect and switch up to 5 saved WiFi networks
b - BLE: Scan nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices

Time & Power
t - Time: Clock toolkit — uptime, system clock, countdown, stopwatch
p - Battery: Real-time battery level + about 1-hour historical curve chart
s - Sleep: Enter light sleep or deep sleep mode

Productivity
c - Cursor: Cursor usage statistics with daily/weekly/monthly trend charts
k - HID Keyboard: Emulate HID keyboard over USB and BLE
j - Morse: Generate audible Morse code tones

System & Info
o - Options: Global system settings (brightness, sound, time, IR parameters etc.)
i - Info: Overview of memory, chip model, firmware, network and runtime status
v - Version: Firmware version and about page

Hardware Debug & Demos
g - IMU: Attitude visualization for BMI270 inertial measurement unit
l - RGB LED: Onboard RGB LED functional test
r - Mic: Real-time audio waveform, VU meter and gain adjustment
d - Display: Screen test patterns including color blocks, grids and lines
a - Icons: Browse all built-in firmware icons
f - Font: Preview embedded system fonts
n / e - I2C: Scan internal on-board I2C bus and external expanded I2C bus respectively

name: StackChan(MP3-Player) for Cardputer & ADV
description:
NOW STACKCHAN CAN PLAY MP3 FILES CONTINUOUSLY AND NEW FACES HAVE BEEN ADDED. ADDED THE FUNCTION TO ADJUST SCREEN BRIGHTNESS. Keys (-) and (=).  ADDED SHUFFLE. Key - (s) 

!!! Brightness Fix !!!

StackChan came to liven up the cardputer's downtime when you're not using it for other things or when it's charging, and now it can groove to MP3s in the background. !!! READ MORE BELOW !!!

This means that when the device is recharging, it won't have a static background, and now you can listen to music while enjoying StackChan's cuteness.

Tip:
When a title balloon is being displayed, press any key to make it disappear.

Controls:

- Key 1 to change the faces
- Key 2 to change the background color
- Key 3 to change the expression 
- Press the '-' key to decrease brightness  
- Press the '=' key to increase brightness.

How to use MP3 Function:

- Copy MP3 files to the SD card, then insert it into the cardputer.
- Turn on the cardputer and wait a few seconds for it to scan.
- Press the (BtnGo) to play music.
- For the next song, press (BtnGo).
- Volume UP: press arrow up (;) 
- Volume DOWN: press arrow down (.)
- N for Next song
- B Previous song
- P Pause/Play
- S Shuffle ON/OFF


Note: still in development!!!

Libraries Dependencies:

- https://github.com/meganetaaan/m5stack-avatar
- https://github.com/earlephilhower/ESP8266Audio/

name: Starship
description:
Starship is a classic, fast-paced arcade game inspired by the legendary "Game & Watch: Eggs" handhelds, reimagined in a space setting.
Your mission is to defend your starship from incoming enemies attacking from all four directions. You must instantly activate your shields to repel them. The game progressively increases in speed and difficulty as your score grows, putting your reflexes and concentration to the ultimate test.
Key Features:
Classic Gameplay: Simple, addictive retro mechanics with a fresh sci-fi twist.
High Score Tracking: The game automatically saves your personal best directly to the device's non-volatile memory—compete against yourself and set new records!
Optimized for M5Cardputer ADV: Specifically designed for the M5Cardputer, utilizing the keyboard and display for maximum responsiveness.
Retro Vibes: Classic pixel art and sound effects that capture the golden age of arcade gaming.
How to Play:
Use the [CTRL], [FN], [ENTER], and [SPACE] keys to activate shields in the corresponding directions. Don't let the enemies break through your defenses!

name: StickS3 Pomodoro Hourglass
description:
A Pomodoro hourglass firmware for the M5Stack StickS3. It transforms the traditional Pomodoro timer into a blue pixel-sand hourglass. The total amount of sand always remains constant and flows steadily according to the selected timer duration. When the device is rotated, the sand dynamically settles based on the IMU gravity direction, while the countdown continues with accurate timing.

name: TETRIS! Single OR Multi-Player Battle!+ - M5StickC Plus2
description:
TETRIS! MULTI-PLAYER!

*There is still a single player mode!

This project represents a significant evolution from a single-player M5StickC Plus2 Tetris game to a full-featured 2-player battle system. While built upon AleksAlcDel's excellent foundation and inspired by Hexagon's advanced concepts, the battle system, enhanced features, and professional polish represent substantial original contribution to the M5Stack Tetris Community. 

*REQUIRES Mini JoyC Hat!
-Multi-Player *Requires 2nd M5StickC Plus2
TO CONNECT- After booting opening screen. First hold down on the JoyC Hat. Then WAIT! about 15-20 seconds and it will create a hotspot. Shortly afterward hold down on JoyC hat on 2nd M5Stick, it will connect quickly. They are supposed to ready up together. Sometimes they do. Sometimes one person opens a few seconds earlier. No matter what the game syncs up and the battle begins. I would however not delay a long time after connecting to each other to ready up.

-20 Levels
-Ghost Piece
-Next Piece  *only displays for a second. Not intentional. 
-Border- to fill the void on the original
-A battle meter! I don't actually know what this does. 
-You can each select your own levels! For multi skill level users. 
-GARBAGE! Clearing. 2 Lines sends ,  3 lines sends 2 and 4 lines sends 4! I was going to make T-spins send 4. But its really not fair, as they are so easy. 
-Press Left button for hold next piece!
-M5 pauses it game
*note: pausing one game does NOT pause the other

-Progressive lock delay! I think it works. not a huge fan of slow speeds, so I really only could tell on the higher level. But its set to go from 450 ms to 650ms at Max level. 
-There is also a left over WiFi monitor hold up... and Tetris beacon on the opening screen if you hold L+R. So. Don't do that unless you want the world to know someone is playing Tetris nearby. 

Only for M5StickC Plus2

Created by Coreymillia

name: TETROIDS! Asteroids Tetris Piece Game M5StickC Plus2
description:
**Mini Joy C Hat Required!!**
TetroidsM5 - Tetris meets Asteroids
A space shooter for M5StickC Plus2 where you pilot a T-piece ship through waves of Tetris asteroid attacks!

  🎮 Game Description
Control a T-piece spaceship that rotates 360° and fires bullets to destroy incoming Tetris-shaped asteroids. Survive waves of tetromino enemies, break them apart, and rack up your high score! Classic arcade action meets block-puzzle aesthetics in this retro-inspired shooter.

🌟 Key Features
360° Ship Rotation - 8-direction smooth rotation with momentum physics
Asteroid Destruction - Shoot Tetris pieces that break into smaller blocks
Progressive Waves - Increasing difficulty with more asteroids
Tetris Aesthetics - Classic piece colors (I=Cyan, O=Yellow, L=Orange, J=Blue, S=Green, Z=Red)
Screen Wrapping - True Asteroids-style edge teleportation
God Mode - Invincibility toggle for testing/practice
Smooth 60 FPS - Buttery gameplay on ESP32
🕹️ Controls
Input	Action
Joystick Left/Right	Rotate ship counter-clockwise/clockwise
Joystick Up	Thrust forward (momentum physics)
Joy Button	Fire bullet (max 4 on screen)
M5  Warp/hyperspace
Button B	Toggle God Mode (invincibility)

How to Play
Survive the Waves - Each wave spawns 3-8 Tetris-shaped asteroids
Shoot to Break - Hit large asteroids to break them into 4 smaller blocks
Destroy All - Clear all asteroids to advance to next wave
Avoid Collisions - Touching asteroids damages you (unless God Mode is on)
Score Points:
Small block destroyed: 10 pts
Large asteroid broken: 50 pts
Wave completed: 100 × wave number
Survival time: 1 pt/second

Design Philosophy
This game combines the best of two arcade classics:
Asteroids (1979): Rotation, thrust, screen wrap, shooting
Tetris (1984): Block aesthetics, piece types, colors
Atari's Asteroids & Alexey Pajitnov's Tetris

Created by Coreymillia

name: Tab5 SSH Client
description:
Tab5 SSH Client is a portable SSH terminal firmware for M5Stack Tab5 with Tab5 Keyboard.

- Interactive SSH client for Linux servers and network devices
- Simple Wi-Fi access point profile manager
- Simple SSH destination profile manager
- Direct SSH command support: ssh user@host[:port]
- Tab5sh: built-in Linux-like local shell
- Scrollback terminal with command history and line editing
- Adjustable terminal font size and line spacing
- microSD-focused lightweight filesystem commands: ls, cd, cat, mkdir, rmdir, df, chmod
- SCP-style file transfer between SSH hosts and the Tab5 microSD card
- Embedded MicroPython REPL and script runner
- M5GFX-backed graphics API for MicroPython scripts
- Graphical Python demos: Mandelbrot, plasma, Life, starfield, maze, and wireframe hat
- Tab5 Keyboard support with local keymap conversion
- USB and BLE keyboard support paths for external keyboards

Bug Hunt - radar-based mutation containment simulator

For this port, buttonA is mapped to Enter/Ok, buttonB is mapped to backspace/delete.

Menu navigation operated with smooth tilt controls! ENJOY!
You'll also find switchable themes, a sound test, stats pages, and more. 
(the heartbeat lets you know it's working!)
***NEW***
Tanooki now supports an optional external ILI9341 2.4" SPI display connected through the Cardputer ADV's EXT 2.54-14P header. 
Pinout:
vcc = 5vin
gnd = gnd
cs = g5
reset = g13
dc = g15     
mosi = g14 
sck = g40
led = 5v out
When enabled, the game canvas is scaled from 240×135 to 320×180 using a fast nearest-neighbor integer scaler running over 40MHz SPI with DMA — filling the larger screen while maintaining crisp pixel art. The display mode is fully automatic: a persistent setting (default ON) controls whether the external screen is used, and a two-second audio-cued boot window lets you switch to the built-in display by pressing any key. The preference is saved to flash and survives reboots!
No hardware modifications are required beyond wiring a standard ILI9341 module to the EXT header with DuPont jumpers or a ribbon cable. The firmware handles SPI bus arbitration, display initialization ordering, and sprite memory management transparently — games don't need to know which display is active. The "Ext Display" toggle in Settings lets you switch modes at any time, with a reboot to apply.

(If you have no display, when loading for the first time you will hear some beeps, you have a few seconds to press any key and it will kill external screen init and pass on to built-in display. Built-in display will then be the default screen unless you enable the external screen again in settings.)

description:
TETRIMINO SPACE INVADERS!
 v1.2
**Requires Mini JoyC Hat**
💥 Particle explosion system - Colorful particles on every hit
🎯 Individual block destruction - Shoot enemies one block at a time
🎨 Random enemy positioning - Organic, scattered formations
💀 Death animations - Player explodes into particles when hit
⏱️ Respawn delay - 2.5 second visual explosion before respawning
🎮 Bottom border - Clean visual floor at screen bottom
✨ Polish - Fixed pixel artifacts and visual glitches

-Game Features
Core Gameplay
Classic Space Invaders with Tetris theme
T-piece player ship at bottom
Enemy formation of small Tetrimino pieces (9×4 grid)
Vertical shooting mechanic
3 lives to start (max 5 with bonuses)
Progressive Difficulty
Wave 1: No enemy shooting, slow movement (800ms delay)
Wave 2: Light enemy shooting (30% chance), faster (750ms)
Wave 3-4: Moderate shooting (50% chance), faster (700-650ms)
Wave 5+: Heavy shooting (80% chance), very fast (600ms+)

-Scoring System
10 points per enemy destroyed
100 points per wave completed
Bonus life every 1000 points (max 5 lives)
Controls
Joystick Left/Right: Move ship horizontally
Joystick Button: Shoot projectile upward
Right Button -Toggle God Mode (invincibility)
M5 - Restart game (when game over)
Enemy Shooting System
Starts at Wave 2
Only frontmost enemies in each column can shoot
Red bullets travel downward
Frequency increases with wave number -射击间隔: 2 seconds minimum between shots
Visual Indicators
Lives: Red squares at top right
Wave: Top left (W#)
Score: Top center (S:#)
God Mode: Yellow bar below HUD
Enemy Alert: Red "!" when enemies can shoot (Wave 2+)
Bonus Life: Green "BONUS LIFE!" message appears (2 seconds)

Based on 1978 Space Invaders by Midway Manufacturing

name: Tetris like game
description:
Classic Tetris game for M5Stack CardPuter with modern
  mechanics.

  All 7 standard Tetris pieces with ghost piece preview, hold
  piece, 7-bag randomizer, wall kicks, lock delay, combo
  scoring and line clear flash animation. 3 music themes
  (Korobeiniki, Bach, Loginska) that change as you level up.
  Hall of Fame with top 5 scores saved to NVS. All settings
  (controls, speed, show next piece) are also saved to NVS and
   persist across reboots.

  Default controls:
  - J / L - Move left / right
  - I - Rotate
  - K - Soft drop
  - SPACE - Hard drop
  - C - Hold piece
  - M - Toggle music
  - P - Pause
  - O - Settings
  - R - Restart

  Arrow cluster ( , . ; / ) also works for navigation in menus
   and gameplay.

  Settings menu (O):
  Use arrow keys ( ; = up, . = down, , = left, / = right ) to
  navigate. Remap any control by selecting it and pressing a
  new key. Duplicate keys are automatically swapped. Press
  ENTER to save and return to game.

  Changelog:
  - 1.0.9 - Refactor codebase into multiple source files
  - 1.0.8 - Fix control settings (intelligent key swapping,
  pause key handling)
  - 1.0.7 - Add modern Tetris mechanics (hold, ghost, 7-bag,
  combos, lock delay, DAS)
  - 1.0.6 - DMA audio with 3 music themes, Hall of Fame with
  NVS persistence

name: Three-Body Problem
description:
A cosmos in your palm — stars dance, trails fade, the universe breathes. But listen. In the deep silence of the night, when the room is dark and your eyes have grown accustomed to the drifting constellations, a faint signal emerges from the tiny speaker. A warning, crossing light-years. You thought you were watching chaos. But chaos was watching you.

掌中宇宙，星移斗转，尾迹如烟。 但且静听。 夜深人静之时，灯熄室暗之后，当你的目光已随星云飘荡许久—— 那微弱的扬声器里，传来一个信号。 跨越光年的警告。 你以为你在欣赏混沌。 但混沌，也在注视着你。（有彩蛋哦）

A living universe on a 135×240 screen. Three stars dance under gravity — their trajectories traced in glowing, fading dots through 3D space. Watch them orbit, collide, and fling each other across the void.

Place it on your desk. After 15 seconds of stillness, it enters **Auto-Demo mode** — the camera drifts, tracking targets cycle randomly, presets shuffle, zoom breathes, and the simulation speeds up and slows down like a living organism. It runs forever, never repeating the same view twice.

Interactive when you want it. Self-playing when you don't.


在 135×240 的小屏幕上，运行着一个活的宇宙。三颗星体在引力中起舞——发光渐隐的尾迹在 3D 空间中划出轨迹。时而优雅盘旋，时而混沌弹射。

放桌上，15 秒静止后进入**自动演示模式**——相机漂移、跟踪随机切换、预设轮换、缩放呼吸、速度忽快忽慢……它自己演出一场永远不会重复的宇宙芭蕾。

想玩就上手，不想动就看着它。

| **Auto-Demo** — idle 15s → cosmic screensaver mode, never repeats | **自动演示** — 15s 空闲 → 宇宙屏保模式，永不重复 |
| **Camera drift** — smooth random sway, like a floating observer | **相机漂移** — 平滑随机摇摆，如同漂浮的观察者 |
| **Bullet-time** — sim speed varies 0.7x–1.5x in demo mode | **子弹时间** — 演示模式速度 0.7x~1.5x 缓慢变化 |
| **Three star layers** — 250 bright stars + 100 distant dim stars + 6 nebula clouds | **三层星场** — 250 亮星 + 100 深空暗星 + 6 片星云 |
| **Depth rendering** — bodies glow brighter when closer, trails fade with depth | **深度渲染** — 星体近亮远暗，尾迹随深度衰减 |
| **6 presets** — Lagrange, Asym, Pytha, Escape, Random, Binary | **6 种预设** — 拉格朗日、非对称、毕达哥拉斯、逃逸、随机、双星 |
| **4 tracking modes** — center of mass or any individual star | **4 种跟踪** — 质心或任一新星体 |
| **3 zoom levels** — 1.2x / 1.0x / 0.5x | **3 档缩放** — 1.2x / 1.0x / 0.5x |
| **IMU view control** — tilt the device to rotate the cosmos | **IMU 视角** — 倾斜板子旋转视角 |
| **Energy display** — real-time system energy on HUD | **能量指示** — HUD 实时显示系统总能量 |
| **800-point trails** — dot-based, fade gradually, never tangle | **800 点尾迹** — 点状渲染、渐变消失、永不缠绕 |

| Button | Action | Function |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Key1 (BtnA)** | Short press | Cycle camera: COM → ① → ② → ③ |
| | Long hold | Pause / Resume |
| **Key2 (BtnB)** | Short press | Cycle preset (6 total) |
| | Long hold | Cycle zoom: 1.2x → 1.0x → 0.5x |

name: Three-Body Problem
description:
A cosmos in your palm — stars dance, trails fade, the universe breathes. But listen. In the deep silence of the night, when the room is dark and your eyes have grown accustomed to the drifting constellations, a faint signal emerges from the tiny speaker. A warning, crossing light-years. You thought you were watching chaos. But chaos was watching you.

掌中宇宙，星移斗转，尾迹如烟。 但且静听。 夜深人静之时，灯熄室暗之后，当你的目光已随星云飘荡许久—— 那微弱的扬声器里，传来一个信号。 跨越光年的警告。 你以为你在欣赏混沌。 但混沌，也在注视着你。（有彩蛋哦）

name: Torta na Cara ADV
description:
Transforme seu M5Cardputer em um verdadeiro sistema de "Passa ou Repassa" / "Show do Milhão"! Este aplicativo é um jogo de trivia dinâmico que testa os reflexos e os conhecimentos dos jogadores. Ele já vem embarcado com um banco de dados de 100 perguntas divertidas (cultura pop, ciências, matemática básica e conhecimentos gerais) prontas para jogar, ideal para crianças e adolescentes.

O grande diferencial deste projeto é a sua flexibilidade de hardware: além de usar o próprio teclado do aparelho, você pode expandir o jogo conectando botões físicos de fliperama (estilo Arcade) diretamente nos pinos superiores da placa, criando uma experiência de competição real de palco.

Como Funciona a Dinâmica
O sistema é ultrarrápido e à prova de empates, desenhado para ser mediado por um "Apresentador" e disputado por dois Jogadores.

    A Tensão (Contagem Regressiva): Cada rodada começa com uma tela laranja e um cronômetro de 5 segundos, acompanhado de bipes sonoros, para que os jogadores posicionem as mãos nos botões.

    O Duelo (A Pergunta): Um apito longo soa e a pergunta sorteada surge na tela para leitura.

    O Buzzer (Trava de Reflexo): O primeiro jogador que apertar o seu botão aciona o alarme. O sistema trava instantaneamente o botão do adversário, ilumina a metade da tela do vencedor (Vermelho para o J1, Azul para o J2) e emite a sirene de parada.

    O Veredito (Revelação): O jogador dá a sua resposta em voz alta. O Apresentador aperta um botão secreto para exibir a resposta correta na tela e julga se o jogador pontua ou leva a "torta na cara".

    Reinicio: Com um simples comando, uma nova pergunta aleatória é puxada do banco de dados e o ciclo recomeça.

Mapeamento de Controles e Pinos Físicos

Controles do Apresentador:

    Tecla R: Revela a resposta correta após alguém bater no buzzer.

    Tecla ENTER: Inicia a próxima rodada com uma nova pergunta.

Controles do Jogador 1 (Lado Esquerdo - Cor Vermelha):

    Teclado: Tecla CTRL.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico entre o pino G5 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND.

Controles do Jogador 2 (Lado Direito - Cor Azul):

    Teclado: Tecla ESPAÇO.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico entre o pino G3 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND.

description:
URC TERMINAL: THE SETTINGS UPDATE [v1.4.1]
Turn your M5Cardputer into a standalone cyberpunk terminal. Connect to the Overseer grid and engage in real-time comms with a retro-hacker aesthetic.
 
🔥 WHAT'S NEW in v1.4.1:
    Settings Panel: New submenu (TAB on Channel Select) to configure your terminal on the fly.
    MSN Sound: Iconic 4-note notification chime recreated on the Cardputer speaker.
    Sound Toggle: Enable or disable all notification sounds. Saved to NVS.
    Screensaver Toggle: Enable or disable the auto-sleep screen timeout. Saved to NVS.
    Brightness Control: 4-step brightness selector (25 / 60 / 120 / 200). Saved to NVS.
    Change WiFi: Rescan and switch networks directly from the Settings panel.
    Anti-Flicker: Partial screen redraws on keypress — no more full-screen flash while typing.
 
📡 FEATURES:
    Grid Persistence: Your Dossier (Age, Country, Bio) and System Prefs survive reboots via NVS.
    Live Tracker: Live active user counts per channel before joining.
    Reputation System: Stars and REP points synced with the Overseer server.
    Private Comms: End-to-end private messaging with PM highlights and LED alerts.
    NeoPixel Alerts: RGB LED color-coded for message type (chat / system / PM).
 
⌨️ QUICK COMMANDS:
    /msg <nick> <text> - Private Encrypted Comms.
    /profile <nick> - Scan user dossier.
    /me - Edit your global profile.
    TAB (in chat) - Smart Reply: target last speaker.
    TAB (in Channel Select) - Open Settings panel.
    Top-Left Key ( ` ) - Native ESC / Disconnect.
    Fn + Up/Down - Scroll chat history.

name: Ultimate Remote - Cardputer & ADV
description:
Works with both cardputer models.

A powerful universal remote control for the M5Cardputer, supporting 3498 remote profiles from 636 different manufacturers and containing around 30,000 commands. It allows you to easily find a suitable remote for you device thanks to a automatic remotes scan.

!! NEW !! - UPDATE 1.2 : Support for the Flipper-IRDB, read .ir files form SD card, also new remotes added.

## Key Features

- Extensive Database: Contains 3498 remote profiles from 636 different manufacturers.
- Protocol Support: Works with more than 60 infrared protocols.
- Massive Command Set: Supports around 30,000 commands.
- Read .ir files from SD card (See Github to get theses files).
- Scan and Find: Allows you to scan for and find the correct remote from a particular manufacturer.
- Favorites: Easily add remotes by pressing SPACE on any remote add it to your favorites.
- Navigation: Navigate through different manufacturer folders to view all available remotes and save them.

## Keybinds

Remote's shortcuts are automatically assigned, however, keys like POWER will always have the shortcut 'P', CHANNEL_UP and CHANNEL_DOWN will always be '[' and ']', and VOL_UP and VOL_DOWN will always be '-+', the same goes for KEY_0 to KEY_9 and some others frequently used commands.

name: Ultrasonic Wind Sensor - ULSA M5B (Demo Firmware)
description:
This firmware is a demonstration firmware for the ULSA M5B, an ultrasonic anemometer that can stack with the M5Stack Core2.
It provides a wind speed and direction gauge, as well as a wind direction correction feature using the Bosch 9-axis sensor BNO055 built into the ULSA.
This firmware is compatible with Core2, Core2 for AWS, and Core2 V1.1.

[Version 2.4 - 2026/04/21]
 - Display Change: Sonic Temperature → Wind Direction
    Tap the wind direction value to switch back to the sonic temperature.

[Version 2.3 - 2026/03/14]
 - Added BLE ON/OFF function
 - Added RTC Time on the display
 - Added NodeID on the display

[Version 2.2 - 2025/10/21]
 - Added support for FAT16 file count limitation
 - Fixed BLE device name bug
 - Improved stability for long-term operation

[Version 2.1 - 2025/09/28]
 - Fixed a bug where, depending on SD card compatibility, log files could suffer data loss or be created as empty files.

 - Changed the logging method to output in 15-minute segments instead of a single file.

 - Implemented an external-power-only mode (“EXT”). When the ULSA is powered via the device’s micro-B port, charging of the internal battery is disabled. This prevents unexpected reboots caused by conflicts between charging and discharging of the internal battery. Tap the battery icon to switch to EXT mode.

[Version 2.0 - 2024/08/04]

 - Supports BLE wireless connection
 - Supports automatic time synchronization via BLE (syncs with the built-in RTC)
 - Supports CSV data logging to an SD card

By accessing the ULSA BLE site using the Web Bluetooth API (https://strvsn.net/P5/ULSA_BLE/), wireless measurement and wireless logging via the browser are possible.

Supported browsers:
PC: Chrome, Edge
Android: Chrome
iOS: Bluefy (logging function not supported)

name: Vesc pocket display
description:
A compact real-time dashboard for VESC-based e-bikes, scooters, or carts, built around the M5StickC Plus2 (ESP32-PICO-V3-02).
This version focuses on readability and performance — no clutter, no bars, just the key live metrics that matter while riding.

🧠 Features

Voltage & Wattage: live battery and power draw from VESC telemetry

MOSFET & Motor Temps: shows controller and motor temperature

Duty Cycle %: live duty output from the controller

Speed (MPH): computed from ERPM using your motor parameters

ESP32 Battery Level: displayed in the top-right corner

BLE Telemetry: communicates with the VESC via Nordic UART Service (NUS)

Update Rate: ~5 Hz (200 ms polling interval)

Minimal UI: clean text layout optimized for sunlight visibility on the M5Stick’s small TFT

🔧 Hardware

M5StickC Plus2 (ESP32-PICO-V3-02)

VESC-compatible controller (UART / BLE enabled)

Optional: custom enclosure or mount for handlebars

📡 Software Stack

M5Unified (display, battery)

NimBLE-Arduino (BLE NUS communication)

Written in Arduino C++, designed for simplicity and reliability

🏁 Usage

Flash the sketch to your M5StickC Plus2.

Power on your VESC with BLE enabled.

The M5Stick automatically scans and connects to your VESC.

Watch live data — voltage, watts, temps, duty, speed, and onboard battery %.

name: Vibot
description:
Vibot 1.0.0 User Guide
Vibot is a tiny AI input controller for M5StickS3. It connects to a computer as a USB HID or BLE HID keyboard, triggers the operating system's built-in dictation, sends prompts, deletes text, and shows a small animated robot UI on the screen.

It is designed for Claude Code, Codex, VS Code, Cursor, browser-based AI chat boxes, and other apps with normal text input fields.

1. Important Notes
Vibot is not a microphone device.
Speech recognition is handled by the computer operating system.
Vibot uses the computer's current microphone, such as the laptop mic, headset mic, or an external mic.
No companion bridge program is required.
2. Connection
USB
Connect Vibot to the computer with a USB-C cable that supports data transfer.
The computer should recognize Vibot as a keyboard.
When the lower-right screen label shows USB, key events are sent through USB.
BLE
Open Bluetooth settings on the computer.
Pair with Vibot-BLE-4B08.
When pairing succeeds and USB is not the active keyboard route, the lower-right screen label shows BLE.
Connection Priority
If USB is available, Vibot uses USB.
If USB is not available and BLE is connected, Vibot uses BLE.
If neither route is ready, the screen shows PAIR or NO HID.
3. Windows Setup
In WIN mode, Vibot sends Win + H when button A is short-pressed.

How to use:

Make sure the top label on Vibot shows WIN.
Click into any text input field.
Short-press A to open Windows voice typing.
Speak, and Windows will enter text into the focused input field.
Short-press A again to stop voice typing.
Press B to send the current content.
Microsoft's voice typing guide says Windows voice typing can be opened in a text field with Windows logo key + H. Reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc-fec94565-c4bd-329d-e59a-af033fa5689f

4. macOS Setup
In MAC mode, Vibot sends Ctrl + Shift + D when button A is short-pressed.

Before using Vibot on a Mac, set the macOS Dictation shortcut to Ctrl + Shift + D.

Setup:

Open macOS System Settings.
Go to Keyboard.
Enable Dictation.
Set the Dictation shortcut to Ctrl + Shift + D.
Switch Vibot to MAC mode.
How to use:

Make sure the top label on Vibot shows MAC.
Click into any text input field.
Short-press A to open macOS Dictation.
Speak, and macOS will enter text into the focused input field.
Short-press A again to stop Dictation.
Press B to send the current content.
Apple's macOS Dictation guide explains that Dictation can be enabled and assigned a keyboard shortcut in Keyboard settings. Reference: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/use-dictation-mh40584/mac

5. Button Actions
Button A
Short-press A:

In WIN mode, sends Win + H.
In MAC mode, sends Ctrl + Shift + D.
Opens or closes system dictation.
Long-press A:

Sends repeated Backspace.
Deletes text before the cursor.
If dictation is active, Vibot first attempts to close dictation, then starts deleting.
The screen shows the DELETE animation while deleting.
Button B
When there is no pending prompt:

Press B to switch between WIN and MAC.
The selected mode is saved after switching.
The bottom label shows B os.
After finishing a dictation segment:

The bottom label shows B send.
Press B to send Enter and submit the current input field content.
While dictation is active:

B does not submit.
B does not interrupt dictation.
The bottom label shows B wait.
6. Screen States
READY: idle and ready.
LISTEN: dictation is active.
THINK: short thinking state after dictation stops.
SEND: sending the current content.
BUILD: waiting for the AI agent to process.
DELETE: deleting text with long-press A.
REST: resting after a long idle period.
The top label shows the host mode:

WIN: Windows mode.
MAC: macOS mode.
The lower-right label shows the active connection:

USB: key events are sent through USB.
BLE: key events are sent through Bluetooth.
PAIR: waiting for Bluetooth connection.
NO HID: no keyboard route is available.
7. Punctuation
Vibot 1.0.0 does not automatically insert commas.

Recommended usage:

Say "comma" when you need a comma.
Say "period" when you need a period.
AI coding agents usually understand continuous dictated Chinese or English, but spoken punctuation makes prompts clearer.
8. Troubleshooting
A does not open dictation
Check the host mode: use WIN for Windows and MAC for macOS.
On Windows, make sure the cursor is inside a text input field.
On macOS, make sure Dictation is enabled and the shortcut is set to Ctrl + Shift + D.
Make sure the lower-right label is not PAIR or NO HID.
Why does B sometimes switch OS mode and sometimes send?
Vibot is a keyboard device, so it cannot read whether the computer's input field is empty.

It uses its own state:

If a dictation segment has just ended, B sends.
If there is no pending prompt, B switches WIN / MAC.
BLE pairs but buttons do nothing
Make sure the lower-right label shows BLE, not PAIR.
If Vibot is still connected to another computer, turn off Bluetooth on that computer or remove the old pairing.
Remove Vibot-BLE-4B08 from Bluetooth settings and pair again.
Long-press A deletes too fast or too slowly
The current version uses repeated Backspace. The repeat speed is controlled by firmware constants and can be adjusted in a later build.

Vibot 1.0.0 使用说明
Vibot 是一款基于 M5StickS3 的小型 AI 输入控制器。它通过 USB HID 或 BLE HID 作为键盘连接电脑，用系统自带语音输入完成文字录入，并用屏幕上的小机器人动画反馈当前状态。

适用场景包括 Claude Code、Codex、VS Code、Cursor、浏览器 AI 对话框和其他可以输入文字的应用。

1. 重要说明
Vibot 本身不是麦克风设备。
语音识别由电脑系统完成，Windows 使用系统语音输入，macOS 使用系统听写。
Vibot 使用电脑当前麦克风，例如笔记本内置麦克风、耳机麦克风或外接麦克风。
Vibot 不需要安装电脑端桥接程序。
2. 连接方式
USB 连接
用支持数据传输的 USB-C 线连接 Vibot 和电脑。
电脑会把 Vibot 识别为键盘。
屏幕右下角显示 USB 时，按键会通过 USB 发送。
BLE 蓝牙连接
在电脑蓝牙设置里搜索设备。
选择 Vibot-BLE-4B08 并配对。
配对成功后，如果 USB 没有作为当前键盘通道，屏幕右下角会显示 BLE。
连接优先级
USB 可用时，优先走 USB。
USB 不可用但 BLE 已连接时，走 BLE。
两者都不可用时，屏幕显示 PAIR 或 NO HID。
3. Windows 使用
Windows 模式下，Vibot 的 A 键会发送 Win + H，打开或关闭 Windows 语音输入。

使用步骤：

确认 Vibot 顶部显示 WIN。
把光标点进任意输入框。
短按 A，打开语音输入。
说话，文字会进入当前输入框。
再短按 A，结束语音输入。
按 B，发送当前内容。
Microsoft 官方说明中，Windows 语音输入可以在文本框中通过 Windows 徽标键 + H 打开。参考：https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc-fec94565-c4bd-329d-e59a-af033fa5689f

4. macOS 使用
macOS 模式下，Vibot 的 A 键会发送 Ctrl + Shift + D。

第一次使用 Mac 前，需要在 macOS 里把听写快捷键设置成 Ctrl + Shift + D。

设置步骤：

打开 macOS System Settings。
进入 Keyboard。
打开 Dictation。
将 Dictation shortcut 设置为 Ctrl + Shift + D。
在 Vibot 上切换到 MAC 模式。
使用步骤：

确认 Vibot 顶部显示 MAC。
把光标点进任意输入框。
短按 A，打开 macOS 听写。
说话，文字会进入当前输入框。
再短按 A，结束听写。
按 B，发送当前内容。
Apple 官方说明中，macOS 听写可在 Keyboard 设置里启用并选择快捷键。参考：https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/use-dictation-mh40584/mac

5. 按键功能
A 键
短按 A：

在 WIN 模式下发送 Win + H。
在 MAC 模式下发送 Ctrl + Shift + D。
用来打开或关闭系统语音输入。
长按 A：

连续发送 Backspace。
用来删除光标前面的文字。
如果正在语音输入，Vibot 会先尝试关闭语音输入，再开始删除。
删除时屏幕显示 DELETE 动画。
B 键
没有待发送内容时：

按 B 切换 WIN / MAC 模式。
切换结果会自动保存，重启后保持。
屏幕底部会显示 B os。
刚结束一段语音输入后：

屏幕底部会显示 B send。
按 B 发送 Enter，提交当前输入框内容。
语音输入正在进行时：

B 不发送内容。
B 不打断语音输入。
屏幕底部显示 B wait。
6. 屏幕状态
READY：待命状态。
LISTEN：语音输入中。
THINK：语音结束后的短暂思考状态。
SEND：正在发送当前内容。
BUILD：发送后等待 AI agent 处理。
DELETE：长按 A 删除文本中。
REST：长时间无操作后的休息状态。
屏幕顶部会显示当前系统模式：

WIN：Windows 模式。
MAC：macOS 模式。
屏幕右下角会显示当前连接状态：

USB：通过 USB 发送按键。
BLE：通过蓝牙发送按键。
PAIR：等待蓝牙连接。
NO HID：当前没有可用键盘连接。
7. 标点输入
当前版本不自动插入逗号。

推荐方式：

需要逗号时，直接说“逗号”。
需要句号时，直接说“句号”。
对 AI coding 场景，连续中文通常也能被 AI agent 理解，但适当说出标点会更清楚。
8. 常见问题
A 键没有打开语音输入
确认当前模式是否正确：Windows 用 WIN，Mac 用 MAC。
Windows 上确认当前焦点在文本输入框。
Mac 上确认听写快捷键已经设置为 Ctrl + Shift + D。
确认屏幕右下角不是 PAIR 或 NO HID。
B 键为什么有时候切系统，有时候发送
Vibot 作为键盘设备，无法读取电脑输入框里是否真的有文字。

它使用自己的状态判断：

如果刚刚结束过一段听写，B 发送。
如果没有待发送内容，B 切换 WIN / MAC。
蓝牙配对成功但按键没反应
确认屏幕右下角显示 BLE，而不是 PAIR。
如果 Vibot 还连着另一台电脑，请先关闭旧电脑蓝牙或断开旧配对。
在系统蓝牙设置里删除旧的 Vibot-BLE-4B08，重新配对。
长按 A 删除太快或太慢
当前版本使用连续 Backspace 删除。删除速度由固件参数控制，默认适合文本编辑。如果需要更快或更慢，可以在后续版本中调整。

description_src:
Vibot 1.0.0 User Guide
Vibot is a tiny AI input controller for M5StickS3. It connects to a computer as a USB HID or BLE HID keyboard, triggers the operating system's built-in dictation, sends prompts, deletes text, and shows a small animated robot UI on the screen.

It is designed for Claude Code, Codex, VS Code, Cursor, browser-based AI chat boxes, and other apps with normal text input fields.

1. Important Notes
Vibot is not a microphone device.
Speech recognition is handled by the computer operating system.
Vibot uses the computer's current microphone, such as the laptop mic, headset mic, or an external mic.
No companion bridge program is required.
2. Connection
USB
Connect Vibot to the computer with a USB-C cable that supports data transfer.
The computer should recognize Vibot as a keyboard.
When the lower-right screen label shows USB, key events are sent through USB.
BLE
Open Bluetooth settings on the computer.
Pair with Vibot-BLE-4B08.
When pairing succeeds and USB is not the active keyboard route, the lower-right screen label shows BLE.
Connection Priority
If USB is available, Vibot uses USB.
If USB is not available and BLE is connected, Vibot uses BLE.
If neither route is ready, the screen shows PAIR or NO HID.
3. Windows Setup
In WIN mode, Vibot sends Win + H when button A is short-pressed.

How to use:

Make sure the top label on Vibot shows WIN.
Click into any text input field.
Short-press A to open Windows voice typing.
Speak, and Windows will enter text into the focused input field.
Short-press A again to stop voice typing.
Press B to send the current content.
Microsoft's voice typing guide says Windows voice typing can be opened in a text field with Windows logo key + H. Reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc-fec94565-c4bd-329d-e59a-af033fa5689f

4. macOS Setup
In MAC mode, Vibot sends Ctrl + Shift + D when button A is short-pressed.

Before using Vibot on a Mac, set the macOS Dictation shortcut to Ctrl + Shift + D.

Setup:

Open macOS System Settings.
Go to Keyboard.
Enable Dictation.
Set the Dictation shortcut to Ctrl + Shift + D.
Switch Vibot to MAC mode.
How to use:

Make sure the top label on Vibot shows MAC.
Click into any text input field.
Short-press A to open macOS Dictation.
Speak, and macOS will enter text into the focused input field.
Short-press A again to stop Dictation.
Press B to send the current content.
Apple's macOS Dictation guide explains that Dictation can be enabled and assigned a keyboard shortcut in Keyboard settings. Reference: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/use-dictation-mh40584/mac

5. Button Actions
Button A
Short-press A:

In WIN mode, sends Win + H.
In MAC mode, sends Ctrl + Shift + D.
Opens or closes system dictation.
Long-press A:

Sends repeated Backspace.
Deletes text before the cursor.
If dictation is active, Vibot first attempts to close dictation, then starts deleting.
The screen shows the DELETE animation while deleting.
Button B
When there is no pending prompt:

Press B to switch between WIN and MAC.
The selected mode is saved after switching.
The bottom label shows B os.
After finishing a dictation segment:

The bottom label shows B send.
Press B to send Enter and submit the current input field content.
While dictation is active:

B does not submit.
B does not interrupt dictation.
The bottom label shows B wait.
6. Screen States
READY: idle and ready.
LISTEN: dictation is active.
THINK: short thinking state after dictation stops.
SEND: sending the current content.
BUILD: waiting for the AI agent to process.
DELETE: deleting text with long-press A.
REST: resting after a long idle period.
The top label shows the host mode:

WIN: Windows mode.
MAC: macOS mode.
The lower-right label shows the active connection:

USB: key events are sent through USB.
BLE: key events are sent through Bluetooth.
PAIR: waiting for Bluetooth connection.
NO HID: no keyboard route is available.
7. Punctuation
Vibot 1.0.0 does not automatically insert commas.

Recommended usage:

Say "comma" when you need a comma.
Say "period" when you need a period.
AI coding agents usually understand continuous dictated Chinese or English, but spoken punctuation makes prompts clearer.
8. Troubleshooting
A does not open dictation
Check the host mode: use WIN for Windows and MAC for macOS.
On Windows, make sure the cursor is inside a text input field.
On macOS, make sure Dictation is enabled and the shortcut is set to Ctrl + Shift + D.
Make sure the lower-right label is not PAIR or NO HID.
Why does B sometimes switch OS mode and sometimes send?
Vibot is a keyboard device, so it cannot read whether the computer's input field is empty.

It uses its own state:

If a dictation segment has just ended, B sends.
If there is no pending prompt, B switches WIN / MAC.
BLE pairs but buttons do nothing
Make sure the lower-right label shows BLE, not PAIR.
If Vibot is still connected to another computer, turn off Bluetooth on that computer or remove the old pairing.
Remove Vibot-BLE-4B08 from Bluetooth settings and pair again.
Long-press A deletes too fast or too slowly
The current version uses repeated Backspace. The repeat speed is controlled by firmware constants and can be adjusted in a later build.

Vibot 1.0.0 使用说明
Vibot 是一款基于 M5StickS3 的小型 AI 输入控制器。它通过 USB HID 或 BLE HID 作为键盘连接电脑，用系统自带语音输入完成文字录入，并用屏幕上的小机器人动画反馈当前状态。

适用场景包括 Claude Code、Codex、VS Code、Cursor、浏览器 AI 对话框和其他可以输入文字的应用。

1. 重要说明
Vibot 本身不是麦克风设备。
语音识别由电脑系统完成，Windows 使用系统语音输入，macOS 使用系统听写。
Vibot 使用电脑当前麦克风，例如笔记本内置麦克风、耳机麦克风或外接麦克风。
Vibot 不需要安装电脑端桥接程序。
2. 连接方式
USB 连接
用支持数据传输的 USB-C 线连接 Vibot 和电脑。
电脑会把 Vibot 识别为键盘。
屏幕右下角显示 USB 时，按键会通过 USB 发送。
BLE 蓝牙连接
在电脑蓝牙设置里搜索设备。
选择 Vibot-BLE-4B08 并配对。
配对成功后，如果 USB 没有作为当前键盘通道，屏幕右下角会显示 BLE。
连接优先级
USB 可用时，优先走 USB。
USB 不可用但 BLE 已连接时，走 BLE。
两者都不可用时，屏幕显示 PAIR 或 NO HID。
3. Windows 使用
Windows 模式下，Vibot 的 A 键会发送 Win + H，打开或关闭 Windows 语音输入。

使用步骤：

确认 Vibot 顶部显示 WIN。
把光标点进任意输入框。
短按 A，打开语音输入。
说话，文字会进入当前输入框。
再短按 A，结束语音输入。
按 B，发送当前内容。
Microsoft 官方说明中，Windows 语音输入可以在文本框中通过 Windows 徽标键 + H 打开。参考：https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc-fec94565-c4bd-329d-e59a-af033fa5689f

4. macOS 使用
macOS 模式下，Vibot 的 A 键会发送 Ctrl + Shift + D。

第一次使用 Mac 前，需要在 macOS 里把听写快捷键设置成 Ctrl + Shift + D。

设置步骤：

打开 macOS System Settings。
进入 Keyboard。
打开 Dictation。
将 Dictation shortcut 设置为 Ctrl + Shift + D。
在 Vibot 上切换到 MAC 模式。
使用步骤：

确认 Vibot 顶部显示 MAC。
把光标点进任意输入框。
短按 A，打开 macOS 听写。
说话，文字会进入当前输入框。
再短按 A，结束听写。
按 B，发送当前内容。
Apple 官方说明中，macOS 听写可在 Keyboard 设置里启用并选择快捷键。参考：https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/use-dictation-mh40584/mac

5. 按键功能
A 键
短按 A：

在 WIN 模式下发送 Win + H。
在 MAC 模式下发送 Ctrl + Shift + D。
用来打开或关闭系统语音输入。
长按 A：

连续发送 Backspace。
用来删除光标前面的文字。
如果正在语音输入，Vibot 会先尝试关闭语音输入，再开始删除。
删除时屏幕显示 DELETE 动画。
B 键
没有待发送内容时：

按 B 切换 WIN / MAC 模式。
切换结果会自动保存，重启后保持。
屏幕底部会显示 B os。
刚结束一段语音输入后：

屏幕底部会显示 B send。
按 B 发送 Enter，提交当前输入框内容。
语音输入正在进行时：

B 不发送内容。
B 不打断语音输入。
屏幕底部显示 B wait。
6. 屏幕状态
READY：待命状态。
LISTEN：语音输入中。
THINK：语音结束后的短暂思考状态。
SEND：正在发送当前内容。
BUILD：发送后等待 AI agent 处理。
DELETE：长按 A 删除文本中。
REST：长时间无操作后的休息状态。
屏幕顶部会显示当前系统模式：

WIN：Windows 模式。
MAC：macOS 模式。
屏幕右下角会显示当前连接状态：

USB：通过 USB 发送按键。
BLE：通过蓝牙发送按键。
PAIR：等待蓝牙连接。
NO HID：当前没有可用键盘连接。
7. 标点输入
当前版本不自动插入逗号。

推荐方式：

需要逗号时，直接说“逗号”。
需要句号时，直接说“句号”。
对 AI coding 场景，连续中文通常也能被 AI agent 理解，但适当说出标点会更清楚。
8. 常见问题
A 键没有打开语音输入
确认当前模式是否正确：Windows 用 WIN，Mac 用 MAC。
Windows 上确认当前焦点在文本输入框。
Mac 上确认听写快捷键已经设置为 Ctrl + Shift + D。
确认屏幕右下角不是 PAIR 或 NO HID。
B 键为什么有时候切系统，有时候发送
Vibot 作为键盘设备，无法读取电脑输入框里是否真的有文字。

它使用自己的状态判断：

如果刚刚结束过一段听写，B 发送。
如果没有待发送内容，B 切换 WIN / MAC。
蓝牙配对成功但按键没反应
确认屏幕右下角显示 BLE，而不是 PAIR。
如果 Vibot 还连着另一台电脑，请先关闭旧电脑蓝牙或断开旧配对。
在系统蓝牙设置里删除旧的 Vibot-BLE-4B08，重新配对。
长按 A 删除太快或太慢
当前版本使用连续 Backspace 删除。删除速度由固件参数控制，默认适合文本编辑。如果需要更快或更慢，可以在后续版本中调整。

description:
Transform your Cardputer ADV into a professional Wi-Fi Spectrum Analyzer and dual-band tactical direction-finding tool! 📡📲

Radar V3.1 ADV evolves into a full diagnostic suite by introducing a completely new 2.4GHz Spectrum Analyzer with True Peak Hold, alongside the high-speed Wi-Fi and BLE tracking engines. Diagnose your home network's health or physically locate wireless targets using your body as an RF shield.

🔥 NEW V3.1 & CORE FEATURES:
• 📊 SPECTRUM ANALYZER: Real-time 2.4GHz channel monitoring. Toggle between Density Bars and Spectral Arcs to physically map overlapping Co-Channel (CCI) and Adjacent Channel (ACI) interference.
• 🧠 SMART CHANNEL ADVISOR: Mathematically calculates interference scores across all 13 channels and grades their purity (A to F) to recommend the absolute best channel for your router.
• 📶 DUAL-BAND RADAR: Independent tracking for Wi-Fi and BLE targets (Smartphones, Smartwatches, Beacons) with live distance estimation (~Xm).
• 🎯 TARGET LOCK & SMART LISTS: DPI payload protection prevents name shifting mid-scan. Inactive devices receive an [OFF] tag and sink to the bottom of the multiplexed Device List.
• 🔄 TACTICAL 360° HUD: New gyroscopic warm-up animation ensures you capture all surrounding networks before jumping into radar mode.
• 📇 ON-BOARD OUI DB: Instantly resolves device manufacturers (Apple, Xiaomi, Garmin) and tags randomized/private MAC addresses.
• 🔊 AUDIO SONAR & CYBER UI: Geiger-counter audio feedback wrapped in a gorgeous retro-futuristic CRT interface.

⚠️ Note: The ESP32-S3 chip scans for BLE devices only, not Bluetooth Classic.

name: WiFi & BLE Security Scanner for M5Stack Core2
description:
Advanced WiFi & BLE Security Scanner for M5Stack Core2

A full-featured wireless security research tool ported from CYDWiFiScanner to the M5Stack Core2. Features a green-on-black hacker terminal UI, 6 scanning modes, BLE skimmer detection, threat logging to SD card, and haptic feedback.
NOTE: When you first boot this in SCAN mode it will show NO networks found until you select the other modes. 

Scanner Modes
Mode	Description
SCAN	Active network scanner — sorted SSID list with RSSI signal bars, channel, and encryption type
PROBE	Probe request sniffer — captures device MACs and the SSIDs they're actively searching for
CHAN	Channel traffic analyzer — live bar chart of frame density across channels 1–13
DAUTH	Deauth / disassoc attack detector — rate-based alerting when your network is under attack
BLE	BLE skimmer hunter — flags suspicious Bluetooth devices by name patterns and OUI prefix
SHADY	Suspicious network analyzer — scores nearby networks for evil twin, PineAP, karma attacks, etc.

Button	Action
Btn A (left)	Previous mode
Btn B (middle)	Clear / reset current mode data
Btn C (right)	Next mode
Other Features

name: Wifi_Rig_CTRL For M5Core2
description:
# Wifi_RIG_CTRL for M5Stack Core2 Ver 2.20 日本語説明は下にあります。 *English version of `M5CoreHamCAT_Core2/README.md`* Firmware that turns an M5Stack Core2 into a remote controller for your radio (rig). Controls the rig via a Raspberry Pi (Wifi_Rig_CTRL FastAPI backend) or directly via ICOM WLAN Remote (CI-V over WiFi), and supports APRS beacon transmission and PTT control via Wifi_Rig_PTT (a separately sold relay board) or Hamlib. by JI1ORE --- ## 1. Included Files | File | Contents | |---|---| | `src/` `include/` `platformio.ini` `merge_bin.py` | Full source (PlatformIO project) | | `M5CoreHamCAT_Core2_v2.20.bin` | Pre-built firmware (merged, flashable directly at address 0x0) | To use the pre-built `.bin` directly, flash it at address 0x0 with esptool or similar. ```bash esptool.py --chip esp32 write_flash 0x0 M5CoreHamCAT_Core2_v2.20.bin ``` To build it yourself, open this folder as a project in PlatformIO (VSCode extension or CLI) and run `Build` / `Upload`. ```bash pio run # build pio run -t upload # build + flash ``` Builds for M5Stack Core2 Tough / M5Stack CoreS3 SE are published in their own folders (`M5CoreHamCAT_Core2Tough` / `M5CoreHamCAT_CoreS3SE`). --- ## 2. Hardware Connections (Port Roles) | Port | Pins | Purpose | |---|---|---| | **Port A** | SDA=G32 / SCL=G33 (+GND/5V) | **Rotary encoder** (connect an M5 genuine I2C encoder unit, Unit Encoder / SKU: U135) | | **Port C** | G13 / G14 (+GND/5V) | **PTT key input (G13) + status LED (G14)**. Details below | ### Port C Wiring (Important) - **G13 ↔ GND**: Connect the PTT contact of an external toggle switch, foot switch, or mechanical key (e.g., M5 genuine SK6812) here. G13 is internally pulled up (`INPUT_PULLUP`), so the switch only needs to be wired between G13 and Port C's GND (no additional pull-up resistor is required). - **G14**: Data input for a WS2812-compatible NeoPixel (single LED). Displays TX/RX status by LED color (see below). > **Important spec**: Actual transmission (PTT ON) only occurs when **both** the > on-screen "PTT" button is ON (`txEnabled`) **and** Port C's G13 is closed (LOW). > Tapping the on-screen "PTT" button alone will not transmit if nothing is connected > to Port C. > Intended operation: use the on-screen "PTT" button to arm transmission, and use an > external switch (e.g., foot switch) to actually key the transmission — a two-stage > safety design. ### Status LED (Port C, G14) Colors | Color | State | |---|---| | Red | **Actually transmitting** (regardless of method: Hamlib / Wifi_Rig_PTT / CI-V) | | Blue | Standing by to transmit (on-screen PTT button ON = armed, PTT method = Wifi_Rig_PTT, not actually transmitting) | | Green | Standing by to transmit (on-screen PTT button ON = armed, PTT method = Hamlib or CI-V) | | Off | On-screen PTT button OFF (transmit disarmed) | ### Screen Orientation The Core2 does not rotate the screen (no upside-down flip); it displays in the normal orientation (screen flip is Core2 Tough only). ### Audio In addition to the built-in mic/speaker, the Core2 can use an external Module Audio (ES8388, I2C: SDA=G21, SCL=G22). On the settings screen (PTT Method screen), you can independently select the speaker output and mic input source (built-in or Module Audio / external); the default is built-in. If you don't use Module Audio, no external wiring is required. --- ## 3. Flow from First Boot to Connection ### 3-1. Boot Screen (Splash) After powering on, the "Wifi_Rig_CTRL" logo is shown, followed by two buttons: **Normal** and **Skip**. - **Normal**: Standard boot. Proceeds through Wi-Fi selection → Raspberry Pi/CI-V connection → rig selection → PTT method selection, confirming settings at each step every time. - **Skip**: Uses the previously saved settings (Wi-Fi, Pi connection target, rig, PTT method) to skip the confirmation screens and connect straight to the main screen. There is a small toggle in the top-left of the screen labeled **"Default: Normal" / "Default: Skip"**. Tapping it to set "Default: Skip" makes the **auto-transition target after 8 seconds of no input become Skip** (tapping the Normal/Skip button directly still takes priority). If you want to always boot with Skip, set this default to Skip once, and from then on it will auto-boot into Skip without any button presses. ### 3-2. Wi-Fi Connection Screen Scans and lists nearby Wi-Fi networks (e.g., Android tethering). Tap an SSID, enter the password, and connect. ### 3-3. Raspberry Pi / CI-V Connection Screen Use **"Pi Mode" / "CI-V"** in the top-right of the screen to switch connection methods. - **Pi Mode** (via Raspberry Pi + rigctld/FastAPI backend) - Hostname (or IP address; mDNS use can be toggled) - API Port / Audio Port - API Key (optional; only needed if the backend requires authentication) - **CI-V** (ICOM WLAN Remote compatible, connects directly to the radio's Wi-Fi, no Pi needed) - Host (the radio's IP address) - Ctrl Port / CIV Port / Addr (hex) (CI-V address) - Username / Password (authentication info configured on the radio) - Timeout (time until the screen turns off when idle) Tap "Connect" after entering the details. ### 3-4. Rig Selection Screen Select the target rig from the list retrieved from the connection target (Pi/CI-V). ### 3-5. PTT Method Selection Screen - **Wifi_PTT**: Sends PTT signals over WiFi/UDP to a separately sold Wifi_Rig_PTT relay (Remotekeyer). Provided as a workaround for ICOM rigs where Hamlib-based CAT PTT causes no modulation to be carried. - Configure PTT Host (mDNS name or IP address) and PTT Port - **Hamlib**: Standard CAT PTT control via rigctld. - Configure PTT Device (serial device) and PTT Type (RTS/DTR) After configuring, tap "OK" to go to the main screen. --- ## 4. Main Screen Operation ### Top Row (Status Display) - Left: currently connected rig model name - Chips in the top right (left to right): 1. **Theme chip** (e.g., "OCN"): tap to cycle the design theme **OCN → AMB → MONO** 2. **Day/Night chip** ("NGT"/"DAY"): tap to switch between night and day display. In day mode, screen brightness is maximized and a high-contrast color scheme is used for better visibility in bright environments. 3. **TX pill**: lights up red while transmitting (Hamlib) or orange while APRS is transmitting Note: The theme and day/night chips can be operated **even while transmitting (PTT ON)**. - Frequency display (large): tap to open the direct frequency entry screen (disabled while transmitting) - S-meter: displays received signal strength as a gradient - Status chips: ST (step size) / PW (power) / MD (mode) / WD (filter width) ### Buttons (4×3 Grid) | Button | Function | |---|---| | Freq | Select frequency (adjust with the rotary encoder) | | Step | Select/change the frequency step size | | Mode | Select/change the operating mode (SSB/CW/FM etc.) | | Wid | Select/change the filter width | | Pow | Select/change the transmit power | | SQL | Select/change the squelch level | | APRS | **Short press**: toggle APRS transmission ON/OFF (requires APRS Enabled setting + GPS position acquired). **Long press (0.7s+)**: open APRS settings screen | | PTT | Toggle the on-screen PTT armed state ON/OFF (actual transmission also requires an external switch on Port C — see "Port C Wiring" above) | | Back | Disconnect and return to the rig selection screen | | SPK | Toggle the speaker (received audio) ON/OFF | | DOWN / UP | Increase/decrease the value of the currently selected item (Freq/Step/Mode/Wid/Pow/SQL) via buttons as well | ### Rotary Encoder (Port A / Unit Encoder) With one of the Freq/Step/Mode/Wid/Pow/SQL buttons selected, turning the encoder adjusts that item's value. --- ## 5. APRS Settings (Long-press the APRS button to open) | Item | Description | |---|---| | APRS Enabled | Enable/disable the APRS feature itself | | Use GPS | When ON, automatically uses location data obtained from Android (Tasker); manual entry fields are locked | | Latitude / Longitude | Manual location when Use GPS = OFF | | APRS TXFreq | APRS beacon transmit frequency | | Baudrate | 1200 / 9600 | | TX Interval | Beacon transmit interval (30/60/120/180/300/600 seconds) | | Callsign / SSID | Own station callsign and SSID | | Path | WIDE1-1 / WIDE1-1,WIDE2-1 / WIDE2-1 / DIRECT / NONE | | Symbol | APRS symbol (icon shown) | | Destination | APRS destination code (TNC type) | | Sound Device | Sound device used on the Pi side | **About GPS location data**: When Use GPS = ON, a Tasker HTTP server must be running on the Android side (see the port/path shown at the bottom of the settings screen). After connecting to Wi-Fi, the M5 periodically fetches location data from Android; if it tries to start APRS transmission without having obtained a location, a "GPS location not acquired" warning is shown and it cannot start (in that case, it automatically attempts to re-fetch once on the spot). --- ## 6. Color Themes | Theme | Characteristics | |---|---| | OCN (Ocean) | Standard color scheme (teal/blue tones) | | AMB (Amber) | Vacuum-tube/VFD-style amber. A calm scheme suited for night operation | | MONO | Achromatic, maximum contrast. Prioritizes visibility | Each theme has a day mode (bright background, high contrast) and a night mode (dark background), independently switchable via the chip in the top-right of the screen. Settings are saved on the device and persist across reboots. --- ## 7. Changes in v2.20 (compared to v2.18) - Updated version label to 2.20 - Relaxed CI-V mode polling interval (200ms → 500ms) to avoid Wi-Fi disconnects caused by load on the radio side - Added retry handling for PTT OFF in CI-V mode (prevents stuck transmission) - Added automatic detection/display of VFO A/B and MAIN/SUB - Added an APRS received-beacon list screen (with distance/bearing display) - Stability improvements: forced termination handling for streamTask, ENOMEM countermeasures, etc. - The Core2 can now also switch between the built-in speaker/mic and an external Module Audio (ES8388) from the PTT Method screen (previously only CoreS3 SE supported this) - Fixed a bug where, when returning from the PTT Method screen to the rig selection screen, an unsaved CAT device/model selection would revert to the previously saved value ## 8. Changes in v2.30 (compared to v2.20) - Updated version label to 2.30 - Pi-connected mode now benefits from the **Raspberry Pi side API** (`api.py`) update, which dynamically detects the actual mode list supported by the connected rig model (e.g. C4FM on the FT-991, D-STAR on the IC-705, etc. — rig-specific digital modes that previously could not be selected now appear in the Mode picker). Since the M5 firmware has no built-in Pi-update feature, applying this change requires either using the **"Update Pi" button in the Android/iOS app once**, or redoing the Raspberry Pi setup (see `RaspberryPiSetup/readme.txt` for details). - Added D-STAR (IC-705/IC-9700) and WFM to the Mode picker in direct CI-V mode (previously available on Android/iOS but missing from the M5 build). - On the RasPi Connect screen, copying a discovered device's IP from "Scan" now automatically switches to "Use IP" mode (API Port / Audio Port are no longer overwritten, keeping your existing settings). - Adjusted the width of the SCAN/Connect buttons on the RasPi Connect screen so the "Connect" label is no longer truncated. - Fixed CI-V filter selection: since the IC-705 only accepts filter 0x01 for D-STAR, filter 0x01 is now sent regardless of the configured width when in D-STAR mode. - Improved the APRS settings screen: changing Enabled / TX Method (rig-modem usage) and pressing OK now stops/restarts APRS transmission on the spot, without needing a screen transition or reconnect. ----------日本語説明------------ # Wifi_RIG_CTRL for M5Stack Core2 Ver 2.20 M5Stack Core2 を無線機（リグ）のリモートコントローラーにするファームウェアです。 Raspberry Pi（Wifi_Rig_CTRL FastAPI バックエンド）または ICOM WLAN Remote（CI-V over WiFi）経由でリグを操作し、 APRSビーコン送出や、Wifi_Rig_PTT（別売のリレー基板）/ Hamlib 経由でのPTT制御に対応します。 by JI1ORE --- ## 1. 同梱ファイル | ファイル | 内容 | |---|---| | `src/` `include/` `platformio.ini` `merge_bin.py` | ソース一式（PlatformIO プロジェクト） | | `M5CoreHamCAT_Core2_v2.20.bin` | ビルド済みファームウェア（マージ済み、0x0番地に書き込み可） | 書き込み済み `.bin` を直接使う場合は、esptool等で 0x0 番地に書き込んでください。 ```bash esptool.py --chip esp32 write_flash 0x0 M5CoreHamCAT_Core2_v2.20.bin ``` 自分でビルドする場合は、PlatformIO（VSCode拡張 または CLI）でこのフォルダをプロジェクトとして開き、 `Build` / `Upload` を実行してください。 ```bash pio run # ビルド pio run -t upload # ビルド＋書き込み ``` M5Stack Core2 Tough / M5Stack CoreS3 SE 向けはそれぞれ別フォルダ（`M5CoreHamCAT_Core2Tough` / `M5CoreHamCAT_CoreS3SE`）で公開しています。 --- ## 2. ハードウェア接続（Port の役割） | Port | ピン | 用途 | |---|---|---| | **Port A** | SDA=G32 / SCL=G33 (+GND/5V) | **ロータリーエンコーダ**（M5純正 I2C エンコーダユニット Unit Encoder / SKU:U135 を接続） | | **Port C** | G13 / G14 (+GND/5V) | **PTTキー入力（G13）＋ステータスLED（G14）**。詳細は下記 | ### Port C の配線（重要） - **G13 ⟷ GND**：外部トグルスイッチ／フットスイッチ／メカニカルキー（M5純正 SK6812 等）のPTT接点をここに接続します。 G13は内部プルアップ（`INPUT_PULLUP`）されているため、スイッチはG13とPort CのGND間に接続するだけでOKです（プルアップ抵抗など追加部品は不要）。 - **G14**：WS2812互換のNeoPixel（1灯）のデータ入力。送受信状態をLEDの色で表示します（後述）。 > **重要な仕様**：実際に送信（PTT ON）されるのは、**画面上の「PTT」ボタンがON（`txEnabled`）** かつ **Port CのG13が閉（LOW）** の**両方が揃ったとき**だけです。 > 画面の「PTT」ボタンだけをタップしても、Port Cに何も接続していなければ送信されません。 > 想定運用：画面の「PTT」ボタンで送信を許可（アーム）しておき、実際の送信タイミングは外部スイッチ（フットスイッチ等）で操作する、という2段構えの安全設計です。 ### ステータスLED（Port C, G14）の色 | 色 | 状態 | |---|---| | 赤 | **実際に送信中**（Hamlib / Wifi_Rig_PTT / CI-V いずれの方式でも） | | 青 | 送信スタンバイ中（画面のPTTボタンON＝アーム済み、PTT方式=Wifi_Rig_PTT、実送信はしていない） | | 緑 | 送信スタンバイ中（画面のPTTボタンON＝アーム済み、PTT方式=Hamlib または CI-V） | | 消灯 | 画面のPTTボタンOFF（送信アーム解除中） | ### 画面の向き Core2 は画面回転（上下反転）は行わず、通常の向きのまま表示します（画面反転は Core2 Tough 版のみ）。 ### オーディオ Core2 は本体内蔵マイク/スピーカーに加え、外部 Module Audio（ES8388、I2C: SDA=G21, SCL=G22）を選べます。 設定画面（PTT Method 画面）でSPK出力先・Mic入力先をそれぞれ内蔵／Module Audio（外部）から独立して選択できます（既定は内蔵）。 Module Audioを使わない場合、外部配線は不要です。 --- ## 3. 初回起動〜接続までの流れ ### 3-1. 起動画面（スプラッシュ） 電源を入れると "Wifi_Rig_CTRL" のロゴ表示後、**Normal** / **Skip** の2つのボタンが表示されます。 - **Normal**：通常起動。Wi-Fi選択 → Raspberry Pi/CI-V接続 → リグ選択 → PTT方式選択、の順に毎回設定を確認しながら進みます。 - **Skip**：前回保存済みの設定（Wi-Fi・Pi接続先・リグ・PTT方式）を使って、確認画面を飛ばして一気にメイン画面まで自動接続します。 画面左上には **「既定:Normal」/「既定:Skip」** の小さいトグルがあります。これをタップして「既定:Skip」にしておくと、 **8秒間何もタップしなかった場合の自動遷移先がSkipになります**（Normal/Skipボタンをその場でタップした場合はそちらが優先されます）。 毎回Skipで起動したい場合は、一度この既定値をSkipにしておけば、以後はボタン操作なしで自動的にSkip起動されます。 ### 3-2. Wi-Fi接続画面 周囲のWi-Fi（Androidテザリング等）をスキャンして一覧表示します。SSIDをタップしてパスワードを入力し接続します。 ### 3-3. Raspberry Pi / CI-V 接続画面 画面右上の **「Pi Mode」/「CI-V」** で接続方式を切り替えます。 - **Pi Mode**（Raspberry Pi + rigctld/FastAPI バックエンド経由） - Hostname（またはIPアドレス。mDNS使用/不使用を切替可） - API Port / Audio Port - API Key（任意。バックエンド側で認証を要求する場合のみ） - **CI-V**（ICOM WLAN Remote互換、無線機のWiFiに直結。Pi不要） - Host（無線機のIPアドレス） - Ctrl Port / CIV Port / Addr(hex)（CI-Vアドレス） - Username / Password（無線機側で設定した認証情報） - Timeout（無操作時の画面消灯までの時間） 入力後「Connect」をタップします。 ### 3-4. リグ選択画面 接続先（Pi/CI-V）から取得したリグ一覧から操作対象を選択します。 ### 3-5. PTT方式選択画面 - **Wifi_PTT**：別売の Wifi_Rig_PTT リレー（Remotekeyer）へWiFi/UDP経由でPTT信号を送る方式。ICOM機でHamlib経由PTTだと変調が乗らない問題を回避するために用意された方式です。 - PTT Host（mDNS名 or IPアドレス）、PTT Port を設定 - **Hamlib**：rigctld 経由で通常のCAT PTT制御を行う方式。 - PTT Device（シリアルデバイス）、PTT Type（RTS/DTR）を設定 設定後「OK」でメイン画面へ遷移します。 --- ## 4. メイン画面の操作方法 ### 上段（ステータス表示） - 左：接続中の機種名 - 右上のチップ（左から）： 1. **テーマチップ**（例:"OCN"）：タップでデザインテーマを **OCN → AMB → MONO** の順に切替 2. **昼夜チップ**（"NGT"/"DAY"）：タップで夜間⇄日中表示に切替。日中モードでは画面輝度を最大にし、明るい場所でも見やすい高コントラスト配色になります 3. **TXピル**：送信中は赤（Hamlib）またはオレンジ（APRS送信中）に点灯 ※ テーマ・昼夜チップは**送信中（PTT ON）でも操作可能**です。 - 周波数表示（大きく表示）：タップで周波数の直接入力画面へ（送信中はタップ無効） - Sメーター：受信信号強度をグラデーションで表示 - ステータスチップ：ST(ステップ幅) / PW(パワー) / MD(モード) / WD(フィルタ幅) ### ボタン（4×3グリッド） | ボタン | 機能 | |---|---| | Freq | 周波数を選択（ロータリーエンコーダで増減） | | Step | 周波数ステップ幅を選択・変更 | | Mode | 運用モード（SSB/CW/FM等）を選択・変更 | | Wid | フィルタ幅を選択・変更 | | Pow | 送信パワーを選択・変更 | | SQL | スケルチレベルを選択・変更 | | APRS | **短押し**：APRS送信のON/OFF切替（要:APRS Enabled設定＋GPS位置情報取得済み）。
**長押し（0.7秒以上）**：APRS設定画面を開く | | PTT | 画面上のPTTアーム状態をON/OFF切替（実際の送信にはPort Cの外部スイッチも必要。上記「Port Cの配線」参照） | | Back | 接続を切ってリグ選択画面へ戻る | | SPK | スピーカー（受信音声）のON/OFF | | DOWN / UP | 選択中の項目（Freq/Step/Mode/Wid/Pow/SQL）の値をボタンでも増減可能 | ### ロータリーエンコーダ（Port A / Unit Encoder） Freq/Step/Mode/Wid/Pow/SQL のいずれかのボタンで項目を選択した状態で回すと、その項目の値を増減できます。 --- ## 5. APRS設定（APRSボタン長押しで表示） | 項目 | 内容 | |---|---| | APRS Enabled | APRS機能自体のON/OFF | | Use GPS | ONの場合、Android(Tasker)から取得した位置情報を自動使用（手動入力欄はロックされる） | | Latitude / Longitude | Use GPS=OFF時の手動位置情報 | | APRS TXFreq | APRSビーコン送信周波数 | | Baudrate | 1200 / 9600 | | TX Interval | ビーコン送信間隔（30/60/120/180/300/600秒） | | Callsign / SSID | 自局コールサイン・SSID | | Path | WIDE1-1 / WIDE1-1,WIDE2-1 / WIDE2-1 / DIRECT / NONE | | Symbol | APRSシンボル（アイコン表示） | | Destination | APRS宛先コード（TNC種別） | | Sound Device | Pi側で使用するサウンドデバイス | **GPS位置情報について**：Use GPS=ON時は、Android側でTasker HTTPサーバー（設定画面下部に表示されるポート・パスを参照）を起動しておく必要があります。 M5はWiFi接続後、定期的にAndroidへ位置情報を取りに行き、取得できていない状態でAPRS送信を開始しようとすると「GPS位置情報未取得」の警告が出て開始できません（その場合はその場で自動的に一度再取得を試みます）。 --- ## 6. 配色テーマ | テーマ | 特徴 | |---|---| | OCN (Ocean) | 標準配色（ティール/ブルー系） | | AMB (Amber) | 真空管・VFD風の琥珀色。夜間運用向けの落ち着いた配色 | | MONO | 無彩色・最大コントラスト。視認性重視 | 各テーマとも昼間モード（明るい背景・高コントラスト）／夜間モード（暗い背景）を持ち、画面右上のチップで独立して切替できます。設定は本体に保存され、再起動後も保持されます。 --- ## 7. v2.20 での変更点（v2.18 との比較） - バージョン表記を 2.20 に更新 - CI-Vモード時のポーリング間隔を緩和（200ms→500ms）し、無線機側の負荷によるWiFi切断を回避 - CI-Vモード時のPTT OFFにリトライ処理を追加（送信固着防止） - VFO A/B・MAIN/SUBの自動判別・表示に対応 - APRS受信ビーコン一覧画面（距離・方位表示）を追加 - streamTask強制終了処理・ENOMEM対策など安定性改善 - Core2でも本体内蔵SPK/Micと外部Module Audio（ES8388）をPTT Method画面から切替可能に（従来はCoreS3 SEのみ対応） - PTT Method画面からリグ選択画面へ戻った際、CATデバイス／機種の未保存の選択が保存済みの値に戻ってしまう不具合を修正 ## 8. v2.30 での変更点（v2.20 との比較） - バージョン表記を 2.30 に更新 - Pi 経由モードは **Raspberry Pi 側 API**（`api.py`）の更新で、接続中の機種が 実際にサポートするモード一覧を動的に検出するようになった（例: FT-991 の C4FM、 IC-705 の D-STAR など、従来は選べなかった機種固有のデジタルモードが Mode 選択に 表示されるようになる）。M5本体にはPi更新機能がないため、反映するには **Android/iOSアプリの「Update Pi」ボタンを一度使うか、Raspberry Piのセットアップ をやり直す**必要がある（詳細は `RaspberryPiSetup/readme.txt` を参照） - CI-V直結モードのMode選択に D-STAR（IC-705/IC-9700）と WFM を追加 （従来はAndroid/iOS版にはあったがM5版のみ選択肢になかった） - RasPi接続画面で「Scan」から検出した機器のIPをコピーした際、自動的に 「Use IP」モードへ切り替わるようにした（API Port / Audio Portはコピーせず、 既存の設定を維持する） - RasPi接続画面のSCAN／Connectボタンの横幅を調整し、「Connect」ラベルが 省略されず表示されるようにした - CI-Vモードのフィルタ選択を修正。D-STAR時はIC-705の仕様上フィルタ0x01のみ 受け付けるため、幅指定に関わらずフィルタ0x01を送信するようにした - APRS設定画面で Enabled / TX Method（リグモデム使用有無）を変更してOKを 押した際、画面遷移や再接続なしにその場でAPRS送受信を停止・再起動するように改善
